+#[test]
+fn two_real_matching_cargo_targets_are_refused_as_ambiguous() -> Result<()> {
+    tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().enable_all().build()?.block_on(async {
+        let workspace = Workspace::new()?;
+        project(&workspace.0.join("a"), "candidate-a", "candidate a")?;
+        project(&workspace.0.join("b"), "candidate-b", "candidate b")?;
+        std::fs::write(workspace.0.join("Cargo.toml"), "[workspace]\nmembers = [\"a\", \"b\"]\nresolver = \"3\"\n")?;
+        std::fs::write(workspace.0.join("Cargo.lock"), "version = 4\n[[package]]\nname = \"candidate-a\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\n[[package]]\nname = \"candidate-b\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\n")?;
+        let error = provider(workspace.0.join("target")).build(&request(&workspace.0, "ambiguous")).await
+            .err().context("two matching binary targets were accepted")?;
+        let observed = error.outcome().context("ambiguous invocation was discarded")?;
+        anyhow::ensure!(observed.artifact.is_none());
+        anyhow::ensure!(observed.refusal.as_deref() == Some("multiple matching compiler artifacts are ambiguous"), "{error}");
+        let invocation = observed.invocation.as_ref().context("original command missing")?;
+        anyhow::ensure!(invocation.succeeded(), "expected real Cargo success before selection refusal: {invocation:?}");
+        let messages = invocation.stdout.bytes.split(|byte| *byte == b'\n')
+            .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(line).ok())
+            .filter(|message| message["reason"] == "compiler-artifact" && message["target"]["name"] == "shenko")
+            .count();
+        anyhow::ensure!(messages == 2, "actual matching compiler messages: {messages}");
+        Ok(())
+    })
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn overflowing_real_compiler_output_is_stopped_and_never_an_artifact() -> Result<()> {
+    tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().enable_all().build()?.block_on(async {
+        let workspace = Workspace::new()?;
+        project(&workspace.0, "bounded-candidate", "candidate")?;
+        std::fs::write(workspace.0.join("Cargo.lock"), "version = 4\n[[package]]\nname = \"bounded-candidate\"\nversion = \"0.1.0\"\n")?;
+        let mut builder = provider(workspace.0.join("target"));
+        builder.limits.stream_bytes = 16;
+        let error = builder.build(&request(&workspace.0, "bounded")).await
+            .err().context("truncated Cargo evidence was accepted")?;
+        let observed = error.outcome().context("overflow lost the original build attempt")?;
+        anyhow::ensure!(observed.artifact.is_none());
+        let invocation = observed.invocation.as_ref().context("overflow invocation missing")?;
+        anyhow::ensure!(invocation.stdout.truncated || invocation.stderr.truncated);
+        anyhow::ensure!(invocation.stdout.bytes.len() <= 16 && invocation.stderr.bytes.len() <= 16);
+        anyhow::ensure!(invocation.local_process_reaped && invocation.stdout.eof && invocation.stderr.eof,
+            "the original child and readers were not settled: {invocation:?}");
+        anyhow::ensure!(invocation.error.is_some() && invocation.cleanup_error.is_none(), "{invocation:?}");
+        Ok(())
+    })
+}"},{"sha":"11e359eb2d0d0d416f74a39cd54ed5f8a7ad79b5","filename":"docs/evidence/ci-3e62c0e5-20261116/source-blobs/11e359eb2d0d0d416f74a39cd54ed5f8a7ad79b5.blob","status":"added","additions":327,"deletions":0,"changes":327,"blob_url":"https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/blob/41d785ae8f968a3e81cd632223cadb356c44a224/docs%2Fevidence%2Fci-3e62c0e5-20261116%2Fsource-blobs%2F11e359eb2d0d0d416f74a39cd54ed5f8a7ad79b5.blob","raw_url":"https://github.com/cyjin-yl/shenko/raw/41d785ae8f968a3e81cd632223cadb356c44a224/docs%2Fevidence%2Fci-3e62c0e5-20261116%2Fsource-blobs%2F11e359eb2d0d0d416f74a39cd54ed5f8a7ad79b5.blob","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/cyjin-yl/shenko/contents/docs%2Fevidence%2Fci-3e62c0e5-20261116%2Fsource-blobs%2F11e359eb2d0d0d416f74a39cd54ed5f8a7ad79b5.blob?ref=41d785ae8f968a3e81cd632223cadb356c44a224","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,327 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Compare real same-tool workspace diagnostics with an immutable PR baseline.
+
+Production and all-target diagnostics have separate per-package/per-lint counts.
+No checked-in warning budget is used. The same compiler enumerates its default
+Rust warnings for the workspace edition and probes which it actually accepts.
+Force-warn keeps these and Clippy's selected lints visible through allow/expect
+attributes. Unwrap/expect counts come only from normal library/binary builds,
+where rustc excludes test code; their complete all-target output is retained.
+The source-policy comparison rejects new suppressions, ignored tests and lint
+changes in either scope.
+"""
+import argparse
+from collections import Counter
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+import tomllib
+
+from base_ref import ROOT, resolve_base
+
+TOOLCHAIN = tomllib.loads((ROOT / 'rust-toolchain.toml').read_text())['toolchain']['channel']
+EDITION = tomllib.loads((ROOT / 'Cargo.toml').read_text())['workspace']['package']['edition']
+CLIPPY_LINTS = ('clippy::all', 'clippy::unwrap_used', 'clippy::expect_used')
+PRODUCTION_ONLY_LINTS = frozenset(CLIPPY_LINTS[1:])
+
+
+def lint_policy(output):
+    # Bind discovery and both source graphs to one native compiler. Inherited
+    # flags or wrappers must not replace that compiler or suppress its lints.
+    environment = dict(os.environ, RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=TOOLCHAIN)
+    for key in ('RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'CLIPPY_ARGS',
+                'RUSTC_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP'):
+        environment.pop(key, None)
+    rustc = subprocess.check_output(
+        ['rustup', 'which', '--toolchain', TOOLCHAIN, 'rustc'], cwd=ROOT, env=environment, text=True).strip()
+    environment['RUSTC'] = rustc
+    command = [rustc, '--edition', EDITION, '-W', 'help']
+    listing = subprocess.check_output(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, text=True)
+    listing_path = output / 'rustc-lints.log'
+    listing_path.write_text(listing)
+    _, start, table = listing.partition('Lint checks provided by rustc:\n')
+    table, end, _ = table.partition('\nLint groups provided by rustc:')
+    rows = [line.split(None, 2) for line in table.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    if not start or not end or rows[:2] != [['name', 'default', 'meaning'], ['----', '-------', '-------']]:
+        raise RuntimeError(f'Unrecognized rustc lint table; retained {listing_path}')
+    levels = {}
+    for row in rows[2:]:
+        if (len(row) != 3 or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9-]*', row[0])
+                or row[1] not in ('allow', 'expect', 'warn', 'force-warn', 'deny', 'forbid')
+                or row[0] in levels):
+            raise RuntimeError(f'Unrecognized rustc lint row {row!r}; retained {listing_path}')
+        levels[row[0]] = row[1]
+    # The special `warnings` group cannot be force-warned. Enumerate individual
+    # warn-by-default IDs instead: plain -W warnings permits source-level allow.
+    # Use this edition's defaults so deny-by-default lints are not downgraded.
+    warnings = sorted(name for name, level in levels.items() if level == 'warn' and name != 'warnings')
+    if not warnings:
+        raise RuntimeError(f'No default Rust warning lints discovered; retained {listing_path}')
+    warnings, probe = accepted_warning_lints(rustc, environment, output, warnings)
+    flags = [argument for name in (*warnings, *CLIPPY_LINTS) for argument in ('--force-warn', name)]
+    policy = {
+        'toolchain': TOOLCHAIN, 'edition': EDITION, 'rustc_path': rustc,
+        'rustc': subprocess.check_output([rustc, '-Vv'], cwd=ROOT, env=environment, text=True),
+        'clippy': subprocess.check_output(
+            ['cargo', 'clippy', '--version'], cwd=ROOT, env=environment, text=True).strip(),
+        'lint_discovery_command': command, 'rust_warning_probe': probe,
+        'rust_warning_lints': warnings, 'flags': flags,
+    }
+    # Retain the shared policy even if the first compilation fails.
+    (output / 'lint-policy.json').write_text(json.dumps(policy, indent=2) + '\n')
+    return environment, policy
+
+
+def accepted_warning_lints(rustc, environment, output, discovered):
+    """Check the listing against the exact compiler's command-line interface.
+
+    Stable rustc may list an unstable lint in -W help, then reject that lint's
+    name when it appears in --force-warn. That creates unknown_lints in every
+    crate, including otherwise clean new crates. Only names this compiler
+    itself rejects in an isolated probe are omitted; source diagnostics and
+    the unknown_lints lint remain part of both workspace comparisons.
+    """
+    source = output / 'rustc-warning-probe.rs'
+    source.write_text('pub fn clippy_ratchet_probe() {}\n')
+    discovered = set(discovered)
+    if 'unknown-lints' not in discovered:
+        raise RuntimeError('Compiler discovery did not include unknown-lints')
+
+    def probe(names, stage):
+        command = [rustc, '--edition', EDITION, '--crate-name', 'shenko_lint_policy_probe',
+                   '--crate-type', 'lib', '--emit', 'metadata', '--error-format', 'json',
+                   *[argument for name in sorted(names) for argument in ('--force-warn', name)],
+                   '-o', str(output / f'rustc-warning-probe-{stage}.rmeta'), str(source)]
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, text=True,
+                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=30)
+        diagnostics_path = output / f'rustc-warning-probe-{stage}.jsonl'
+        diagnostics_path.write_text(result.stderr)
+        (output / f'rustc-warning-probe-{stage}.stdout.log').write_text(result.stdout)
+        receipt = {'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode,
+                   'diagnostics': diagnostics_path.name, 'source': source.read_text()}
+        (output / f'rustc-warning-probe-{stage}.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
+        if result.returncode or result.stdout:
+            raise RuntimeError(f'rustc lint probe failed; retained {diagnostics_path}')
+        rejected = set()
+        warnings = 0
+        summaries = []
+        for line in result.stderr.splitlines():
+            diagnostic = json.loads(line)
+            code = (diagnostic.get('code') or {}).get('code')
+            message = diagnostic.get('message', '')
+            unknown = re.fullmatch(r'unknown lint: `([a-z][a-z0-9_-]*)`', message)
+            summary = re.fullmatch(r'(\d+) warnings? emitted', message)
+            if (diagnostic.get('$message_type') != 'diagnostic'
+                    or diagnostic.get('level') != 'warning'):
+                raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected rustc probe diagnostic; retained {diagnostics_path}')
+            if code == 'unknown_lints' and unknown:
+                name = unknown[1].replace('_', '-')
+                if name not in names or name == 'unknown-lints':
+                    raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected rejected lint {name!r}; retained {diagnostics_path}')
+                rejected.add(name)
+                warnings += 1
+            elif code is None and summary:
+                summaries.append(int(summary[1]))
+            else:
+                raise RuntimeError(f'Unexpected rustc probe warning; retained {diagnostics_path}')
+        if summaries != ([warnings] if warnings else []):
+            raise RuntimeError(f'Inconsistent rustc probe warning count; retained {diagnostics_path}')
+        return rejected, receipt
+
+    rejected, initial = probe(discovered, 'discovered')
+    accepted = sorted(discovered - rejected)
+    remaining, verified = probe(accepted, 'accepted')
+    if remaining:
+        raise RuntimeError(f'Compiler still rejects filtered lint policy: {sorted(remaining)}')
+    return accepted, {'discovered_lints': sorted(discovered), 'unavailable_lints': sorted(rejected),
+                      'initial': initial, 'verified': verified}
+
+
+def tracked(root):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '-z'], cwd=root).decode().split('\0')[:-1]
+
+
+def rust_tokens(source):
+    """Read attributes without mistaking strings or nested comments for code."""
+    index = 0
+    while index < len(source):
+        if source[index].isspace():
+            index += 1
+        elif source.startswith('//', index):
+            end = source.find('\n', index)
+            index = len(source) if end < 0 else end + 1
+        elif source.startswith('/*', index):
+            depth = 1
+            index += 2
+            while depth:
+                if index >= len(source):
+                    raise ValueError('Unterminated Rust block comment')
+                if source.startswith('/*', index):
+                    depth += 1
+                    index += 2
+                elif source.startswith('*/', index):
+                    depth -= 1
+                    index += 2
+                else:
+                    index += 1
+        else:
+            raw = re.match(r'(?:br|cr|r)(#*)"', source[index:])
+            if raw:
+                end = source.find('"' + raw[1], index + raw.end())
+                if end < 0:
+                    raise ValueError('Unterminated Rust raw string')
+                end += 1 + len(raw[1])
+            elif source[index] == '"':
+                end = index + 1
+                while end < len(source) and source[end] != '"':
+                    end += 2 if source[end] == '\\' else 1
+                end += 1
+            else:
+                character = re.match(r"'(?:\\(?:u\{[0-9a-fA-F_]+\}|x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|.)|[^'\\\n])'", source[index:])
+                word = re.match(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*', source[index:])
+                end = index + (character.end() if character else word.end() if word else 1)
+            yield source[index:end]
+            index = end
+
+
+def source_policy(root):
+    controls = Counter()
+    configuration = {}
+    for name in tracked(root):
+        path = root / name
+        if name.endswith('.rs'):
+            tokens = list(rust_tokens(path.read_text()))
+            index = 0
+            while index < len(tokens):
+                if tokens[index] != '#':
+                    index += 1
+                    continue
+                start = index
+                index += 1
+                if index < len(tokens) and tokens[index] == '!':
+                    index += 1
+                if index >= len(tokens) or tokens[index] != '[':
+                    continue
+                depth = 1
+                index += 1
+                while depth and index < len(tokens):
+                    depth += (tokens[index] == '[') - (tokens[index] == ']')
+                    index += 1
+                attribute = tokens[start:index]
+                if {'allow', 'expect', 'ignore'} & set(attribute):
+                    controls[(name, ' '.join(attribute))] += 1
+        elif path.name == 'Cargo.toml':
+            manifest = tomllib.loads(path.read_text())
+            for section, table in [('lints', manifest.get('lints', {})),
+                                   ('workspace.lints', manifest.get('workspace', {}).get('lints', {}))]:
+                for tool, entries in table.items():
+                    if not isinstance(entries, dict):
+                        continue
+                    for lint, value in entries.items():
+                        level = value.get('level') if isinstance(value, dict) else value
+                        if level in ('allow', 'expect'):
+                            controls[(name, f'{section}.{tool}.{lint}={json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True)}')] += 1
+        elif path.name in ('clippy.toml', '.clippy.toml') or name.endswith(('.cargo/config', '.cargo/config.toml')):
+            configuration[name] = path.read_bytes()
+    return controls, configuration
+
+
+def collect(root, target, output, selection, environment, lint_flags, *, production):
+    environment = dict(environment, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target))
+    metadata = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(
+        ['cargo', 'metadata', '--locked', '--no-deps', '--format-version=1'], cwd=root, env=environment, text=True))
+    members = set(metadata['workspace_members'])
+    packages = {package['id']: package['name'] for package in metadata['packages'] if package['id'] in members}
+    # Match the Rust job's optional Poppy assembly in both immutable trees.
+    # Building the protocol workspace member alone does not compile the bin's
+    # feature-gated account, transport and commerce handlers.
+    command = ['cargo', 'clippy', '--workspace', '--features', 'shenko/compat-poppy',
+               '--locked', '-j2', '--message-format=json', *selection, '--', *lint_flags]
+    counts = Counter()
+    production_only = Counter()
+    artifacts = set()
+    finished = False
+    print(f'{root}: {" ".join(command)}', flush=True)
+    with output.with_suffix('.jsonl').open('w') as log, output.with_suffix('.stderr.log').open('w') as errors:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=root, env=environment, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=errors)
+        for line in process.stdout:
+            log.write(line)
+            log.flush()
+            record = json.loads(line)
+            if record.get('reason') == 'build-finished':
+                finished = record['success']
+            if record.get('package_id') not in packages:
+                continue
+            if record.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact':
+                artifacts.add(packages[record['package_id']])
+            if record.get('reason') == 'compiler-message':
+                diagnostic = record['message']
+                if diagnostic['level'] in ('warning', 'error'):
+                    print(diagnostic.get('rendered') or diagnostic['message'], flush=True)
+                if diagnostic['level'] == 'warning':
+                    code = (diagnostic.get('code') or {}).get('code') or diagnostic['message']
+                    key = (packages[record['package_id']], code)
+                    if code in PRODUCTION_ONLY_LINTS and not production:
+                        production_only[key] += 1
+                    else:
+                        counts[key] += 1
+        status = process.wait()
+    if status or not finished or not artifacts:
+        raise RuntimeError(f'Clippy failed ({status}) in {root}; retained {output.with_suffix(".stderr.log")}')
+    return counts, production_only
+
+
+def diagnostic_counts(counts):
+    return [{'package': key[0], 'lint': key[1], 'count': count}
+            for key, count in sorted(counts.items())]
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--base', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=ROOT / '.ci/evidence/clippy')
+    parser.add_argument('--target-root', type=Path, default=ROOT / '.ci/target/clippy')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    base = resolve_base(args.base)
+    output = args.output.resolve()
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    environment, policy = lint_policy(output)
+    baseline = output / 'baseline'
+    subprocess.run(['git', 'worktree', 'add', '--detach', str(baseline), base], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
+    base_controls, base_configuration = source_policy(baseline)
+    current_controls, current_configuration = source_policy(ROOT)
+    errors = [f'New suppression/ignored test: {name}: {attribute}'
+              for name, attribute in sorted((current_controls - base_controls).elements())]
+    if base_configuration != current_configuration:
+        errors.append('Clippy/Cargo configuration differs from the immutable baseline; lint policy cannot lower its own gate')
+    comparisons = {}
+    for scope, selection in [('production', ['--lib', '--bins']), ('all-targets', ['--all-targets'])]:
+        old, old_production_only = collect(
+            baseline, args.target_root.resolve() / 'baseline' / scope, output / f'base-{scope}', selection,
+            environment, policy['flags'], production=scope == 'production')
+        new, new_production_only = collect(
+            ROOT, args.target_root.resolve() / 'candidate' / scope, output / f'candidate-{scope}', selection,
+            environment, policy['flags'], production=scope == 'production')
+        comparisons[scope] = {
+            'cargo_target_selection': selection,
+            'production_only_lints_compared': scope == 'production',
+            'baseline': diagnostic_counts(old), 'candidate': diagnostic_counts(new),
+            'baseline_uncompared_production_only_diagnostics': diagnostic_counts(old_production_only),
+            'candidate_uncompared_production_only_diagnostics': diagnostic_counts(new_production_only),
+        }
+        errors.extend(f'{scope}: {package}: {lint} increased by {count}'
+                      for (package, lint), count in sorted((new - old).items()))
+    receipt = {'baseline': base, 'candidate': subprocess.check_output(
+        ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
+        **policy, 'comparisons': comparisons, 'errors': errors}
+    receipt['production_only_lints'] = sorted(PRODUCTION_ONLY_LINTS)
+    (output / 'ratchet.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
+    if errors:
+        raise SystemExit('\n'.join(errors))
+    print('Compiler/Clippy warnings and production unwrap/expect diagnostics do not exceed the immutable baseline')
+

+name: CI
+
+on:

+    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review, edited]
+  merge_group:

+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      base-sha:
+        description: Full independently reviewed ancestor SHA for the ratchets

+        type: string

+permissions:
+  contents: read

+concurrency:
+  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+defaults:
+  run:
+    shell: bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail {0}

+env:

+  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '0'
+  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG: '0'
+  CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG: '0'

+jobs:
+  rust:

+    container: rust:1.98.1-bookworm

+    env:
+      CARGO_TARGET_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.ci/target/rust
+      SHENKO_COMPAT_EVIDENCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/.ci/evidence/compat
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          persist-credentials: false
+      # Checkout writes safe.directory under a temporary HOME. After each
+      # checkout, register only the runtime workspace in the restored shell

+      - name: Trust the checked-out workspace in the container shell

+      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
+        with:
+          workspaces: . -> .ci/target/rust

+          mkdir -p .ci/evidence

+          echo 'b761e3a0721dbae9c09a0059e5fdb2bf917d1b4a8a7b430fb3b5aafb0984b2c4  .ci/toolchains/wasi-sdk.tar.gz' | sha256sum --check --strict

+          python3 crates/shenko-wasm/ports/ssh-wasi/build.py \

+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

+    steps:

+//! Checkout metadata is an observation, not an immutable source snapshot.

+use std::process::Stdio;

+const OUTPUT_TAIL_BYTES: usize = 8 * 1024;

+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]

+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct BuildRequest {

+}
+
+impl BuildRequest {
+    pub fn new(source_dir: impl Into<PathBuf>, generation: RuntimeGeneration) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            source_dir: source_dir.into(), generation, profile: BuildProfile::Release,
+            target: None, extra_args: Vec::new(), binary_name: "shenko".into(),

+/// Finite collection limits of this build provider, recorded in each attempt.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct BuildLimits {

+    pub stream_bytes: usize,
+}
+
+impl Default for BuildLimits {

+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct CandidateArtifact {
+    pub generation: RuntimeGeneration,
+    pub path: PathBuf,
+    pub digest: Digest,
+    pub bytes: u64,
+    /// Equal, clean checkout HEAD observations before and after this build.
+    /// Even this does not attest ignored files, environment or immutable inputs.
+    pub source_revision: Option<String>,
+    pub lockfile_digest: Option<Digest>,
+    pub manifest_digest: Option<Digest>,
+    /// Cargo's observed version in the build directory, not a compiler attestation.
+    pub toolchain: String,
+    /// The requested profile and target; the receipt also retains Cargo's actual
+    /// compiler profile and exact arguments, including additional arguments.
+    pub profile: BuildProfile,
+    pub target: Option<String>,
+    pub built_at: String,
+}

+/// Exact retained bytes. Overflow is a failed observation, never a valid build
+/// whose compiler messages were silently discarded.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct CapturedStream {
+    pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
+    pub observed_bytes: u64,
+    pub eof: bool,
+    pub truncated: bool,
+    pub error: Option<String>,
+}
+
+impl CapturedStream {
+    fn append(&mut self, bytes: &[u8], limit: usize) {
+        self.observed_bytes = self.observed_bytes.saturating_add(bytes.len() as u64);
+        let retained = limit.saturating_sub(self.bytes.len()).min(bytes.len());
+        self.bytes.extend_from_slice(&bytes[..retained]);
+        self.truncated |= retained != bytes.len();
+    }
+
+    fn complete(&self) -> bool { self.eof && !self.truncated && self.error.is_none() }
+
+    fn seal(&self, cas: &ContentStore, name: &str) -> anyhow::Result<serde_json::Value> {
+        let object = cas.seal_object(&self.bytes, "application/octet-stream", "activation", name, 1)?.object;
+        Ok(serde_json::json!({
+            "raw_ref": object, "observed_bytes": self.observed_bytes,
+            "eof": self.eof, "truncated": self.truncated, "error": self.error,
+        }))
+    }
+}

+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct CommandObservation {
+    pub command: Vec<String>,
+    pub cwd: PathBuf,
+    pub explicit_target_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
+    pub limits: BuildLimits,
+    pub started_at: String,
+    pub finished_at: String,
+    pub pid: Option<u32>,
+    pub exit_code: Option<i32>,
+    pub local_process_reaped: bool,
+    pub stdout: CapturedStream,
+    pub stderr: CapturedStream,
+    pub error: Option<String>,
+    pub cleanup_error: Option<String>,
+}
+
+impl CommandObservation {
+    fn succeeded(&self) -> bool {
+        self.exit_code == Some(0) && self.local_process_reaped && self.error.is_none()
+            && self.cleanup_error.is_none() && self.stdout.complete() && self.stderr.complete()
+    }
+
+    fn seal(&self, cas: &ContentStore) -> anyhow::Result<serde_json::Value> {
+        Ok(serde_json::json!({
+            "command": self.command, "cwd": self.cwd, "explicit_target_dir": self.explicit_target_dir,
+            "limits": self.limits, "started_at": self.started_at, "finished_at": self.finished_at,
+            "pid": self.pid, "exit_code": self.exit_code, "local_process_reaped": self.local_process_reaped,
+            "stdout": self.stdout.seal(cas, "build-stdout")?,
+            "stderr": self.stderr.seal(cas, "build-stderr")?,
+            "error": self.error, "cleanup_error": self.cleanup_error,
+        }))
+    }
+}

+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct FileObservation {
+    pub path: PathBuf,
+    pub digest: Option<Digest>,
+    pub bytes: Option<u64>,
+    pub error: Option<String>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct SourceObservation {
+    pub head: CommandObservation,
+    pub status: CommandObservation,
+    pub manifest: FileObservation,
+    pub lockfile: FileObservation,
+}
+
+impl SourceObservation {
+    fn clean_head(&self) -> Option<String> {
+        if !self.head.succeeded() || !self.status.succeeded() || !self.status.stdout.bytes.is_empty() {
+            return None;
+        }
+        let head = std::str::from_utf8(&self.head.stdout.bytes).ok()?.trim();
+        ((head.len() == 40 || head.len() == 64) && head.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()))
+            .then(|| head.to_owned())
+    }
+
+    fn seal(&self, cas: &ContentStore) -> anyhow::Result<serde_json::Value> {
+        Ok(serde_json::json!({
+            "head": self.head.seal(cas)?, "status": self.status.seal(cas)?,
+            "manifest": self.manifest, "lockfile": self.lockfile,
+            "source_snapshot_frozen": false,
+        }))
+    }
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct BuildOutputLayout {
+    pub provider_root_preference: Option<PathBuf>,
+    pub environment_root_preference: Option<PathBuf>,
+    pub argument_root_preference: Option<PathBuf>,
+    pub cargo_metadata_root: PathBuf,
+    pub canonical_preferred_root: PathBuf,
+    pub owned_directory: PathBuf,
+}
+
+/// One original observation. Cargo artifacts require their own complete
+/// successful compiler stream. Prebuilt inputs explicitly have no invocation.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct BuildOutcome {
+    pub build_id: EntityId,
+    pub request: Option<BuildRequest>,
+    pub artifact: Option<CandidateArtifact>,
+    pub exit_code: i32,
+    pub stdout_tail: String,
+    pub stderr_tail: String,
+    pub command: Vec<String>,
+    pub invocation: Option<CommandObservation>,
+    pub cargo_version: Option<CommandObservation>,
+    pub cargo_metadata: Option<CommandObservation>,
+    pub output_layout: Option<BuildOutputLayout>,
+    pub source_before: Option<SourceObservation>,
+    pub source_after: Option<SourceObservation>,
+    pub compiler_artifact: Option<serde_json::Value>,
+    pub refusal: Option<String>,
+}
+
+impl BuildOutcome {
+    fn new(request: BuildRequest, command: Vec<String>) -> Self {
+        Self {
+            build_id: EntityId::new(), request: Some(request), artifact: None, exit_code: -1,
+            stdout_tail: String::new(), stderr_tail: String::new(), command,
+            invocation: None, cargo_version: None, cargo_metadata: None, output_layout: None,
+            source_before: None, source_after: None,
+            compiler_artifact: None, refusal: None,
+        }
+    }
+
+    pub fn prebuilt(path: &Path, generation: &RuntimeGeneration) -> Result<Self, BuildError> {
+        let mut outcome = Self::new(BuildRequest::new(PathBuf::new(), generation.clone()),
+            vec![path.to_string_lossy().into_owned()]);
+        outcome.request = None;
+        outcome.artifact = Some(match describe_artifact(path, generation) {
+            Ok(artifact) => artifact,
+            Err(error) => return Err(outcome.refuse(format!("prebuilt artifact cannot be read: {error}"))),
+        });
+        outcome.exit_code = 0;
+        Ok(outcome)
+    }
+
+    fn refuse(mut self, reason: impl Into<String>) -> BuildError {
+        let reason = reason.into();
+        self.refusal = Some(reason.clone());
+        BuildError::Attempt { reason, outcome: Box::new(self) }
+    }
+
+    /// Seal original streams separately so no UTF-8 replacement or inline
+    /// transcript limit can change their bytes. The caller roots this JSON in
+    /// an activation closure or the existing durable error journal.
+    pub fn seal(&self, cas: &ContentStore) -> anyhow::Result<ObjectRef> {
+        let body = serde_json::json!({
+            "schema_version": 1, "build_id": self.build_id, "request": self.request,
+            "artifact": self.artifact, "exit_code": self.exit_code, "command": self.command,
+            "stdout_tail": self.stdout_tail, "stderr_tail": self.stderr_tail,
+            "invocation": self.invocation.as_ref().map(|value| value.seal(cas)).transpose()?,
+            "cargo_version": self.cargo_version.as_ref().map(|value| value.seal(cas)).transpose()?,
+            "cargo_metadata": self.cargo_metadata.as_ref().map(|value| value.seal(cas)).transpose()?,
+            "output_layout": self.output_layout,
+            "source_before": self.source_before.as_ref().map(|value| value.seal(cas)).transpose()?,
+            "source_after": self.source_after.as_ref().map(|value| value.seal(cas)).transpose()?,
+            "compiler_artifact": self.compiler_artifact, "refusal": self.refusal,
+            "source_snapshot_frozen": false, "reproducible_build_proven": false,
+            "validation_tests_executed_by_builder": false,
+            "prebuilt_content_observation": self.request.is_none(),
+        });
+        Ok(cas.seal_object(&serde_json::to_vec(&body)?, "application/json", "activation", "build-receipt", 1)?.object)
+    }
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
+pub enum BuildError {
+    #[error("candidate build failed: {reason}")]
+    Attempt { reason: String, outcome: Box<BuildOutcome> },
+    #[error("io error: {0}")]
+    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
+}
+
+impl BuildError {
+    pub fn outcome(&self) -> Option<&BuildOutcome> {
+        match self { Self::Attempt { outcome, .. } => Some(outcome), Self::Io(_) => None }
+    }
+}
+
+#[async_trait::async_trait]
+pub trait BuildProvider: Send + Sync {
+    async fn build(&self, request: &BuildRequest) -> Result<BuildOutcome, BuildError>;
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct CargoBuildProvider {
+    pub cargo: PathBuf,
+    /// Root preference; each build uses its own newly created child directory.
+    pub target_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
+    pub limits: BuildLimits,
+}
+
+impl Default for CargoBuildProvider {
+    fn default() -> Self { Self::new("cargo") }
+}
+
+impl CargoBuildProvider {
+    pub fn new(cargo: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> Self {
+        Self { cargo: cargo.into(), target_dir: None, limits: BuildLimits::default() }
+    }
+}
+
+#[async_trait::async_trait]
+impl BuildProvider for CargoBuildProvider {
+    async fn build(&self, request: &BuildRequest) -> Result<BuildOutcome, BuildError> {
+        let mut args = vec!["build".to_owned(), "--locked".to_owned(),
+            "--message-format=json-render-diagnostics".to_owned(), "--bin".to_owned(), request.binary_name.clone()];
+        if request.profile == BuildProfile::Release { args.push("--release".into()); }
+        if let Some(target) = &request.target { args.extend(["--target".into(), target.clone()]); }
+        args.extend(request.extra_args.iter().cloned());
+        let mut command_line = vec![self.cargo.to_string_lossy().into_owned()];
+        command_line.extend(args.iter().cloned());
+        let mut outcome = BuildOutcome::new(request.clone(), command_line);
+        let extras = match normalized_arguments(&request.extra_args) {
+            Ok(extras) => extras,
+            Err(error) => return Err(outcome.refuse(error)),
+        };
+        if self.limits.timeout_ms == 0 || self.limits.stream_bytes == 0 {
+            return Err(outcome.refuse("build collection limits must be positive"));
+        }
+        let source = match std::fs::canonicalize(&request.source_dir) {
+            Ok(path) => path,
+            Err(error) => return Err(outcome.refuse(format!("source directory unavailable: {error}"))),
+        };
+        outcome.source_before = Some(observe_source(&source).await);
+        outcome.cargo_version = Some(observe_command(&self.cargo, &["--version".into(), "--verbose".into()],
+            &source, None, &probe_limits()).await);
+        let environment_root = std::env::var_os("CARGO_TARGET_DIR").map(PathBuf::from);
+        let metadata_root_preference = self.target_dir.as_deref().or(environment_root.as_deref());
+        let mut metadata_args = vec!["metadata".into(), "--no-deps".into(), "--format-version=1".into(), "--locked".into()];
+        metadata_args.extend(extras.metadata.iter().cloned());
+        let metadata_observation = observe_command(&self.cargo, &metadata_args, &source,
+            metadata_root_preference, &BuildLimits { timeout_ms: 15_000, stream_bytes: 4 * 1024 * 1024 }).await;
+        outcome.cargo_metadata = Some(metadata_observation);
+        let metadata = match outcome.cargo_metadata.as_ref().filter(|observation| observation.succeeded()) {
+            Some(observation) => match serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(&observation.stdout.bytes) {
+                Ok(metadata) => metadata,
+                Err(error) => return Err(outcome.refuse(format!("Cargo metadata is not valid JSON: {error}"))),
+            },
+            None => return Err(outcome.refuse("Cargo target-root metadata did not complete successfully; see its original observation")),
+        };
+        if metadata["version"].as_u64() != Some(1) {
+            return Err(outcome.refuse("Cargo metadata format version is not 1"));
+        }
+        let layout = match owned_output_layout(outcome.build_id, &source, self.target_dir.as_deref(),
+            environment_root.as_deref(), extras.target_root.as_deref(), &metadata) {
+            Ok(layout) => layout,
+            Err(error) => return Err(outcome.refuse(format!("owned build output cannot be prepared: {error}"))),
+        };
+        let owned = layout.owned_directory.clone();
+        outcome.output_layout = Some(layout);
+        let owned_arg = match owned.to_str() {
+            Some(path) => path.to_owned(),
+            None => return Err(outcome.refuse("owned output path is not representable in Cargo JSON evidence")),
+        };
+        // Original extra arguments remain in the request. Only the explicit
+        // root preference is replaced by this attempt's unique output tree.
+        args.truncate(args.len() - request.extra_args.len());
+        args.extend(extras.build);
+        args.extend(["--target-dir".into(), owned_arg]);
+        outcome.command = vec![self.cargo.to_string_lossy().into_owned()];
+        outcome.command.extend(args.iter().cloned());
+        let invocation = observe_command(&self.cargo, &args, &source, Some(&owned), &self.limits).await;
+        outcome.exit_code = invocation.exit_code.unwrap_or(-1);
+        outcome.stdout_tail = tail(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&invocation.stdout.bytes));
+        outcome.stderr_tail = tail(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&invocation.stderr.bytes));
+        outcome.invocation = Some(invocation);
+        outcome.source_after = Some(observe_source(&source).await);
+        let invocation = match outcome.invocation.as_ref() {
+            Some(value) => value,
+            None => return Err(outcome.refuse("build invocation observation is missing")),
+        };
+        if !invocation.succeeded() {
+            let reason = format!("Cargo did not complete successfully: exit={:?}, observation={:?}, cleanup={:?}; {}",
+                invocation.exit_code, invocation.error, invocation.cleanup_error, outcome.stderr_tail);
+            return Err(outcome.refuse(reason));
+        }
+        let message = match select_artifact(&invocation.stdout.bytes, request, &source, &owned, &metadata) {
+            Ok(value) => value,
+            Err(reason) => return Err(outcome.refuse(reason)),
+        };
+        let path = match message.get("executable").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str) {
+            Some(path) => match std::fs::canonicalize(path) {
+                Ok(path) => path,
+                Err(error) => return Err(outcome.refuse(format!("reported executable disappeared: {error}"))),
+            },
+            None => return Err(outcome.refuse("the selected compiler message has no executable")),
+        };
+        outcome.compiler_artifact = Some(message);
+        let mut artifact = match describe_artifact(&path, &request.generation) {
+            Ok(value) => value,
+            Err(error) => return Err(outcome.refuse(format!("the reported artifact cannot be read: {error}"))),
+        };
+        artifact.profile = request.profile;
+        artifact.target = request.target.clone();
+        artifact.toolchain = outcome.cargo_version.as_ref().filter(|value| value.succeeded())
+            .map(|value| String::from_utf8_lossy(&value.stdout.bytes).trim().to_owned())
+            .unwrap_or_else(|| "cargo version unobserved; see original probe".into());
+        if let (Some(before), Some(after)) = (&outcome.source_before, &outcome.source_after) {
+            if before.clean_head() == after.clean_head() { artifact.source_revision = before.clean_head(); }
+            let observed_workspace = metadata["workspace_root"].as_str()
+                .and_then(|path| std::fs::canonicalize(path).ok()).as_ref() == Some(&source);
+            if observed_workspace {
+                if before.lockfile.digest == after.lockfile.digest { artifact.lockfile_digest = before.lockfile.digest.clone(); }
+                if before.manifest.digest == after.manifest.digest { artifact.manifest_digest = before.manifest.digest.clone(); }
+            }
+        }
+        outcome.artifact = Some(artifact);
+        Ok(outcome)
+    }
+}

+/// Cargo's own message names the executable; no cache-layout or mtime fallback.
+fn select_artifact(
+    stdout: &[u8], request: &BuildRequest, source: &Path, owned: &Path,
+    metadata: &serde_json::Value,
+) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
+    let mut selected = None;
+    let mut finished = false;
+    for line in stdout.split(|byte| *byte == b'\n') {
+        if line.len() > MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES { return Err("compiler message exceeds the finite record bound".into()); }
+        if !line.starts_with(b"{") { continue; }
+        let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(line)
+            .map_err(|error| format!("malformed Cargo JSON evidence: {error}"))?;
+        match value.get("reason").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str) {
+            Some("build-finished") => {
+                if finished || value.get("success").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_bool) != Some(true) {
+                    return Err("Cargo did not report one successful build-finished event".into());
+                }
+                finished = true;
+            }
+            Some("compiler-artifact") => {
+                if finished { return Err("compiler artifact arrived after build-finished".into()); }
+                let target = &value["target"];
+                if target["name"].as_str() != Some(request.binary_name.as_str())
+                    || target["kind"] != serde_json::json!(["bin"])
+                    || value["profile"]["test"].as_bool() != Some(false) { continue; }
+                let executable = value["executable"].as_str().filter(|path| !path.is_empty())
+                    .ok_or_else(|| "matching compiler artifact has no executable".to_owned())?;
+                if !Path::new(executable).is_absolute() { return Err("compiler executable path is not absolute".into()); }
+                let canonical_executable = std::fs::canonicalize(executable)
+                    .map_err(|error| format!("compiler executable cannot be verified: {error}"))?;
+                if !canonical_executable.starts_with(owned) {
+                    return Err("compiler executable is outside this build's owned output tree".into());
+                }
+                let package = value["package_id"].as_str().filter(|id| !id.is_empty());
+                let manifest = value["manifest_path"].as_str().map(PathBuf::from)
+                    .ok_or_else(|| "compiler artifact has no manifest identity".to_owned())?;
+                let manifest = std::fs::canonicalize(manifest)
+                    .map_err(|error| format!("compiler manifest cannot be verified: {error}"))?;
+                if package.is_none() || !manifest.starts_with(source) {
+                    return Err("compiler artifact package is outside the requested source observation".into());
+                }
+                validate_metadata_target(metadata, &value, &manifest)?;
+                if value["filenames"].as_array().is_none_or(|paths|
+                    !paths.iter().any(|path| path.as_str() == Some(executable))) {
+                    return Err("compiler executable is absent from its artifact filenames".into());
+                }
+                if selected.replace(value).is_some() { return Err("multiple matching compiler artifacts are ambiguous".into()); }
+            }
+            _ => {}
+        }
+    }
+    if !finished { return Err("Cargo build-finished evidence is missing".into()); }
+    selected.ok_or_else(|| "Cargo did not report the requested binary artifact".into())
+}

+struct NormalizedArguments {
+    build: Vec<String>,
+    metadata: Vec<String>,
+    target_root: Option<PathBuf>,
+}
+
+fn normalized_arguments(arguments: &[String]) -> Result<NormalizedArguments, String> {
+    let mut normalized = NormalizedArguments { build: Vec::new(), metadata: Vec::new(), target_root: None };
+    let mut manifest_seen = false;
+    let mut index = 0;
+    while let Some(argument) = arguments.get(index) {
+        if argument == "--" || argument.starts_with("-C") {
+            return Err("extra arguments cannot change the Cargo working directory or terminate managed arguments".into());
+        }
+        if ["--message-format", "--artifact-dir", "--out-dir", "--lockfile-path"].iter().any(|name|
+            argument.as_str() == *name || argument.starts_with(&format!("{name}="))) {
+            return Err("extra arguments cannot override managed compiler evidence, output, or lockfile semantics".into());
+        }
+        let mut handled = false;
+        for name in ["--target-dir", "--manifest-path", "--config"] {
+            let prefix = format!("{name}=");
+            let value = if argument == name {
+                index += 1;
+                Some(arguments.get(index).filter(|value| !value.starts_with('-'))
+                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("{name} requires an unambiguous value"))?.as_str())
+            } else { argument.strip_prefix(&prefix) };
+            let Some(value) = value else { continue };
+            if value.is_empty() { return Err(format!("{name} cannot be empty")); }
+            match name {
+                "--target-dir" => {
+                    if normalized.target_root.replace(PathBuf::from(value)).is_some() {
+                        return Err("multiple --target-dir root preferences are ambiguous".into());
+                    }
+                }
+                _ => {
+                    if name == "--manifest-path" {
+                        if manifest_seen { return Err("multiple --manifest-path arguments are ambiguous".into()); }
+                        manifest_seen = true;
+                    }
+                    normalized.build.extend([name.to_owned(), value.to_owned()]);
+                    normalized.metadata.extend([name.to_owned(), value.to_owned()]);
+                }
+            }
+            handled = true;
+            break;
+        }
+        if !handled {
+            normalized.build.push(argument.clone());
+            if argument == "--offline" || argument == "--frozen" {
+                normalized.metadata.push(argument.clone());
+            }
+        }
+        index += 1;
+    }
+    Ok(normalized)
+}

+fn owned_output_layout(
+    build_id: EntityId, source: &Path, provider_root: Option<&Path>, environment_root: Option<&Path>,
+    argument_root: Option<&Path>, metadata: &serde_json::Value,
+) -> Result<BuildOutputLayout, String> {
+    let metadata_root = metadata["target_directory"].as_str().map(PathBuf::from)
+        .filter(|path| path.is_absolute()).ok_or_else(|| "Cargo did not report an absolute target_directory".to_owned())?;
+    let preferred = argument_root.unwrap_or(&metadata_root);
+    let preferred = if preferred.is_absolute() { preferred.to_owned() } else { source.join(preferred) };
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(&preferred).map_err(|error| format!("target root creation: {error}"))?;
+    let preferred = std::fs::canonicalize(preferred).map_err(|error| format!("target root identity: {error}"))?;
+    let attempts = preferred.join(".shenko-builds");
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(&attempts).map_err(|error| format!("owned output parent: {error}"))?;
+    let attempts = std::fs::canonicalize(attempts).map_err(|error| format!("owned output parent identity: {error}"))?;
+    if !attempts.starts_with(&preferred) { return Err("owned output parent escaped its canonical target root".into()); }
+    let owned = attempts.join(build_id.to_string());
+    std::fs::create_dir(&owned).map_err(|error| format!("unique build output creation: {error}"))?;
+    let owned = std::fs::canonicalize(owned).map_err(|error| format!("owned output identity: {error}"))?;
+    if !owned.starts_with(&attempts) { return Err("owned output escaped its unique parent".into()); }
+    Ok(BuildOutputLayout {
+        provider_root_preference: provider_root.map(Path::to_owned),
+        environment_root_preference: environment_root.map(Path::to_owned),
+        argument_root_preference: argument_root.map(Path::to_owned),
+        cargo_metadata_root: metadata_root,
+        canonical_preferred_root: preferred,
+        owned_directory: owned,
+    })
+}

+fn validate_metadata_target(
+    metadata: &serde_json::Value, artifact: &serde_json::Value, manifest: &Path,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let packages = metadata["packages"].as_array().ok_or_else(|| "Cargo metadata packages are missing".to_owned())?;
+    let mut matching = packages.iter().filter(|package| package["id"] == artifact["package_id"]);
+    let package = matching.next().ok_or_else(|| "compiler package is absent from the original metadata".to_owned())?;
+    if matching.next().is_some() { return Err("metadata package identity is ambiguous".into()); }
+    let metadata_manifest = package["manifest_path"].as_str().ok_or_else(|| "metadata manifest is missing".to_owned())?;
+    if std::fs::canonicalize(metadata_manifest).map_err(|error| error.to_string())? != manifest {
+        return Err("compiler manifest differs from the original package metadata".into());
+    }
+    let declared = package["targets"].as_array().is_some_and(|targets| targets.iter().any(|target|
+        target["name"] == artifact["target"]["name"] && target["kind"] == artifact["target"]["kind"]
+            && target["src_path"] == artifact["target"]["src_path"]));
+    if !declared { return Err("compiler target differs from the original workspace metadata".into()); }
+    Ok(())
+}

+fn probe_limits() -> BuildLimits { BuildLimits { timeout_ms: 15_000, stream_bytes: PROBE_OUTPUT_BYTES } }

+async fn observe_source(source: &Path) -> SourceObservation {

+        status: observe_command(Path::new("git"), &["status".into(), "--porcelain=v1".into(), "-z".into(), "--untracked-files=all".into()], source, None, &probe_limits()).await,

+fn observe_file(path: &Path) -> FileObservation {
+    use std::io::Read;
+    let mut observation = FileObservation { path: path.to_owned(), digest: None, bytes: None, error: None };
+    let result = (|| -> std::io::Result<Vec<u8>> {
+        let file = std::fs::File::open(path)?;
+        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
+        file.take((MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES + 1) as u64).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
+        if bytes.len() > MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES { return Err(std::io::Error::other("source metadata exceeds observation bound")); }
+        Ok(bytes)
+    })();
+    match result {
+        Ok(bytes) => { observation.bytes = Some(bytes.len() as u64); observation.digest = Some(Digest::blake3(&bytes)); }
+        Err(error) => observation.error = Some(error.to_string()),
+    }
+    observation
+}

+struct BuildChild {
+    child: Child,
+    tree: OwnedTree,
+    settled: bool,
+}
+
+impl Drop for BuildChild {
+    fn drop(&mut self) {
+        if !self.settled {
+            let mut notes = CleanupNotes::default();
+            self.tree.stop(&mut notes);
+            let _ = self.child.start_kill();
+            tracing::warn!(cleanup = ?notes.describe(), "build observer dropped before join; no terminal build receipt is claimed");
+        }
+    }

+async fn observe_command(program: &Path, args: &[String], cwd: &Path, target_dir: Option<&Path>, limits: &BuildLimits) -> CommandObservation {
+    let mut command_line = vec![program.to_string_lossy().into_owned()];
+    command_line.extend(args.iter().cloned());
+    let mut report = CommandObservation {
+        command: command_line, cwd: cwd.to_owned(), explicit_target_dir: target_dir.map(Path::to_owned),
+        limits: limits.clone(), started_at: now(), finished_at: String::new(), pid: None,
+        exit_code: None, local_process_reaped: false, stdout: CapturedStream::default(),
+        stderr: CapturedStream::default(), error: None, cleanup_error: None,
+    };
+    let Some(deadline) = tokio::time::Instant::now().checked_add(Duration::from_millis(limits.timeout_ms)) else {
+        report.error = Some("command deadline is not representable".into());
+        report.finished_at = now();
+        return report;
+    };
+    let mut command = Command::new(program);
+    command.args(args).current_dir(cwd).stdin(Stdio::null()).stdout(Stdio::piped()).stderr(Stdio::piped());
+    if let Some(target_dir) = target_dir { command.env("CARGO_TARGET_DIR", target_dir); }
+    OwnedTree::configure(&mut command);
+    let tree = match OwnedTree::before_spawn() {
+        Ok(tree) => tree,
+        Err(error) => { report.error = Some(error.to_string()); report.finished_at = now(); return report; }
+    };
+    let child = match command.spawn() {
+        Ok(child) => child,
+        Err(error) => { report.error = Some(format!("process did not spawn: {error}")); report.finished_at = now(); return report; }
+    };
+    let mut owner = BuildChild { child, tree, settled: false };
+    report.pid = owner.child.id();
+    if let Err(error) = owner.tree.adopt(&owner.child) { report.error = Some(error.to_string()); }
+    let stdout = owner.child.stdout.take();
+    let stderr = owner.child.stderr.take();
+    let (Some(mut stdout), Some(mut stderr)) = (stdout, stderr) else {
+        report.error = Some("spawned process did not expose its configured output pipes".into());
+        report.cleanup_error = owner.tree.retire(&mut owner.child).await.describe();
+        report.local_process_reaped = owner.child.try_wait().is_ok_and(|status| status.is_some());
+        owner.settled = report.local_process_reaped;
+        report.finished_at = now();
+        return report;
+    };
+    let mut out_buffer = [0u8; 8192];
+    let mut err_buffer = [0u8; 8192];
+    // Keep the leader unreaped until the streams finish. If collection fails,
+    // its still-reserved pid anchors the group stop; an unread pipe buffer after
+    // reaping would not prove the old group still exists and its id is reusable.
+    while report.error.is_none() && !report.local_process_reaped {
+        tokio::select! {
+            _ = tokio::time::sleep_until(deadline) => {
+                report.error = Some("command or output observation deadline elapsed".into());
+            }
+            _status = owner.child.wait(), if report.stdout.eof && report.stderr.eof => {
+                match _status {
+                    Ok(status) => { report.exit_code = status.code(); report.local_process_reaped = true; }
+                    Err(error) => report.error = Some(format!("process wait failed: {error}")),
+                }
+            }
+            _count = stdout.read(&mut out_buffer), if !report.stdout.eof => {
+                observe_read(&mut report.stdout, _count, &out_buffer, limits.stream_bytes);
+                if report.stdout.truncated || report.stdout.error.is_some() { report.error = Some("stdout observation is incomplete".into()); }
+            }
+            _count = stderr.read(&mut err_buffer), if !report.stderr.eof => {
+                observe_read(&mut report.stderr, _count, &err_buffer, limits.stream_bytes);
+                if report.stderr.truncated || report.stderr.error.is_some() { report.error = Some("stderr observation is incomplete".into()); }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if report.error.is_some() {
+        report.cleanup_error = owner.tree.retire(&mut owner.child).await.describe();
+        match owner.child.try_wait() {
+            Ok(Some(status)) => { report.local_process_reaped = true; report.exit_code = status.code(); }
+            Ok(None) => report.local_process_reaped = false,
+            Err(error) => append_cleanup(&mut report.cleanup_error, format!("process reap observation failed: {error}")),
+        }
+        let drain = async {
+            tokio::join!(drain_output(&mut stdout, &mut report.stdout, limits.stream_bytes),
+                drain_output(&mut stderr, &mut report.stderr, limits.stream_bytes));
+        };
+        if tokio::time::timeout(RETIRE_JOIN, drain).await.is_err() {
+            append_cleanup(&mut report.cleanup_error, "output readers did not reach EOF after owned process stop".into());
+        }
+    }
+    owner.settled = report.local_process_reaped && report.stdout.eof && report.stderr.eof;
+    report.finished_at = now();
+    report
+}

+fn observe_read(stream: &mut CapturedStream, result: std::io::Result<usize>, buffer: &[u8], limit: usize) {
+    match result {
+        Ok(0) => stream.eof = true,
+        Ok(count) => stream.append(&buffer[..count], limit),
+        Err(error) => stream.error = Some(error.to_string()),
+    }
+}
+
+async fn drain_output(pipe: &mut (impl tokio::io::AsyncRead + Unpin), stream: &mut CapturedStream, limit: usize) {
+    let mut buffer = [0u8; 8192];
+    while !stream.eof {
+        let count = pipe.read(&mut buffer).await;
+        let failed = count.is_err();
+        observe_read(stream, count, &buffer, limit);
+        if failed { break; }
+    }
+}
+
+fn append_cleanup(existing: &mut Option<String>, error: String) {
+    if let Some(previous) = existing { previous.push_str("; "); previous.push_str(&error); }
+    else { *existing = Some(error); }
+}

+fn tail(text: &str) -> String {
+    if text.len() <= OUTPUT_TAIL_BYTES { return text.to_owned(); }
+    let boundary = text.len() - OUTPUT_TAIL_BYTES;
+    let start = text.char_indices().find(|(index, _)| *index >= boundary).map_or(text.len(), |(index, _)| index);
+    text[start..].to_owned()
+}

+//! The one physical PTY owner: bounded admission, same-FIFO flush receipts,
+//! cancellation, and retained close/join. No Store or lease authority is granted.
+
+use crate::native_transport::{
+    NativePtyEvent, NativePtyObservation, NativePtySession, NativePtyStopHandle,
+    NativePtyWriteInput, NativePtyWriteReceipt, NativePtyWriteState, NativeSshError,
+};
+use crate::seat::{AnswerConfirmation, AnswerTransport, SeatAdapterId, SeatResponse};
+use crate::terminal::TerminalScreen;
+use anyhow::{Context, Result};
+use russh::Sig;
+use shenko_types::{EntityId, object::Digest};
+use std::collections::VecDeque;
+use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex as SyncMutex, atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering}};
+use std::time::Duration;
+use tokio::sync::{Mutex, OwnedSemaphorePermit, Semaphore, mpsc, oneshot, watch};
+use tokio::task::JoinHandle;
+
+const COMMAND_LIMIT: usize = 32;
+const CLOSE_GRACE: Duration = Duration::from_millis(500);
+const PUMP_JOIN_WAIT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
+
+struct WriteStatus {
+    state: NativePtyWriteState,
+    error: Option<String>,
+    local_stream_closed: bool,
+}
+
+struct WriteRecord {
+    id: EntityId,
+    input: NativePtyWriteInput,
+    input_digest: String,
+    writer_epoch: u64,
+    status: SyncMutex<WriteStatus>,
+}
+
+impl WriteRecord {
+    fn new(input: NativePtyWriteInput, writer_epoch: u64) -> Self {
+        let bytes = match &input {
+            NativePtyWriteInput::Data { bytes } => bytes.as_slice(),
+            NativePtyWriteInput::SignalInt => b"INT",
+        };
+        Self {
+            id: EntityId::new(), input_digest: Digest::blake3(bytes).0, input, writer_epoch,
+            status: SyncMutex::new(WriteStatus {
+                state: NativePtyWriteState::Queued, error: None, local_stream_closed: false,
+            }),
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn snapshot(&self) -> NativePtyWriteReceipt {
+        let status = self.status.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+        NativePtyWriteReceipt {
+            schema: "ssh.pty-write.v1", write_id: self.id, input: self.input.clone(),
+            input_digest: self.input_digest.clone(), writer_epoch: self.writer_epoch,
+            state: status.state, error: status.error.clone(),
+            local_stream_closed: status.local_stream_closed,
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn refuse(&self, reason: String) {
+        let mut status = self.status.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+        status.state = NativePtyWriteState::NotSent;
+        status.error = Some(reason);
+    }
+}
+
+struct Command {
+    record: Arc<WriteRecord>,
+    completed: oneshot::Sender<()>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Default)]
+struct Journal {
+    stopped: Option<String>,
+    outstanding: VecDeque<Arc<WriteRecord>>,
+    last_completed: Option<Arc<WriteRecord>>,
+}
+
+struct Control {
+    journal: SyncMutex<Journal>,
+    stop: NativePtyStopHandle,
+    closing: watch::Sender<bool>,
+    slots: Arc<Semaphore>,
+    open: AtomicBool,
+}
+
+impl Control {
+    fn admit(&self, command: Command, permit: mpsc::Permit<'_, Command>) -> Result<(), String> {
+        // Admission and stop share this short local lock. No await, SQLite
+        // lock, or external I/O occurs while it is held. An outstanding queue
+        // permit cannot enqueue application bytes after stop has won.
+        let mut journal = self.journal.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+        if let Some(reason) = &journal.stopped { return Err(reason.clone()); }
+        journal.outstanding.push_back(Arc::clone(&command.record));
+        permit.send(command);
+        Ok(())
+    }
+
+    fn begin(&self, record: &WriteRecord) -> bool {
+        let journal = self.journal.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+        if journal.stopped.is_some() { return false; }
+        let mut status = record.status.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+        if status.state != NativePtyWriteState::Queued { return false; }
+        status.state = NativePtyWriteState::Writing;
+        true
+    }
+
+    fn stop_locked(&self, journal: &mut Journal, reason: &str, force_stream: bool) {
+        let writing = journal.outstanding.iter().any(|record| {
+            record.status.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).state
+                == NativePtyWriteState::Writing
+        });
+        let stream_closed = force_stream || writing;
+        if stream_closed {
+            // Serialize with the original OwnedStream's actual nonblocking
+            // I/O poll. Once this returns no queued application command can
+            // perform another inner write, even before this task is polled.
+            self.stop.stop_writes();
+        }
+        if journal.stopped.is_none() { journal.stopped = Some(reason.into()); }
+        self.slots.close();
+        self.open.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
+        for record in &journal.outstanding {
+            let mut status = record.status.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+            match status.state {
+                NativePtyWriteState::Queued => status.state = NativePtyWriteState::NotSent,
+                NativePtyWriteState::Writing => status.state = NativePtyWriteState::Unknown,
+                _ => continue,
+            }
+            status.error = Some(reason.into());
+            status.local_stream_closed = stream_closed;
+        }
+        self.closing.send_replace(true);
+    }
+
+    fn stop(&self, reason: &str, force_stream: bool) {
+        let mut journal = self.journal.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+        self.stop_locked(&mut journal, reason, force_stream);
+    }
+
+    fn finish(&self, record: &WriteRecord, result: Result<(), NativeSshError>) {
+        let mut journal = self.journal.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+        match result {
+            Ok(()) => {
+                let mut status = record.status.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+                // A concurrent cancellation can already have settled Unknown.
+                // A later-polled successful future never erases that fact.
+                if status.state == NativePtyWriteState::Writing {
+                    status.state = NativePtyWriteState::LocallyFlushed;
+                }
+            }
+            Err(error) => {
+                let original = format!("{error:#}");
+                self.stop_locked(&mut journal, &original, true);
+                let mut status = record.status.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+                // Preserve a separately observed original transport error even
+                // if cancellation settled the same command immediately before it.
+                if status.error.as_deref() != Some(original.as_str()) {
+                    status.error = Some(match status.error.take() {
+                        Some(previous) => format!("{previous}; {original}"),
+                        None => original,
+                    });
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    fn acknowledged(&self, record: &Arc<WriteRecord>) {
+        let mut journal = self.journal.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+        if journal.stopped.is_none() {
+            journal.outstanding.retain(|other| other.id != record.id);
+            journal.last_completed = Some(Arc::clone(record));
+        }
+    }

+    fn snapshots(&self) -> Vec<NativePtyWriteReceipt> {

+enum WriteEvent {

+    Remote(Option<NativePtyEvent>),
+    Finished(Result<(), NativeSshError>),

+impl Pump {
+    async fn write_active(&mut self, record: &WriteRecord) {
+        if !self.control.begin(record) { return; }
+        let (receiver, writer) = self.session.split_io();
+        let mut writing = Box::pin(async {
+            match &record.input {
+                NativePtyWriteInput::Data { bytes } => writer.send(bytes).await,
+                NativePtyWriteInput::SignalInt => writer.signal(Sig::INT).await,
+            }
+        });
+        loop {
+            let event = tokio::select! {
+                biased;
+                () = wait_for_close(&mut self.close_rx) => WriteEvent::Stop,
+                result = &mut writing => WriteEvent::Finished(result),
+                event = receiver.recv() => WriteEvent::Remote(event),
+            };
+            match event {
+                WriteEvent::Stop => break,
+                WriteEvent::Finished(result) => {
+                    self.control.finish(record, result);
+                    break;
+                }
+                WriteEvent::Remote(Some(NativePtyEvent::Output(bytes) | NativePtyEvent::Error(bytes))) => {
+                    self.screen.lock().await.feed(&bytes);
+                }
+                WriteEvent::Remote(_) => {
+                    self.control.stop("PTY remote stream ended before the original write receipt", true);
+                    break;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    async fn run(mut self) -> NativePtyObservation {
+        loop {
+            let event = tokio::select! {
+                biased;
+                () = wait_for_close(&mut self.close_rx) => PumpEvent::Stop,
+                event = self.session.recv() => PumpEvent::Remote(event),
+                command = self.commands.recv() => PumpEvent::Command(command),
+            };
+            match event {
+                PumpEvent::Stop | PumpEvent::Command(None) => break,
+                PumpEvent::Remote(Some(NativePtyEvent::Output(bytes) | NativePtyEvent::Error(bytes))) => {
+                    self.screen.lock().await.feed(&bytes);
+                }
+                PumpEvent::Remote(_) => break,
+                PumpEvent::Command(Some(command)) => {
+                    let record = Arc::clone(&command.record);
+                    // The original command/receipt sender remains owned across
+                    // every await, including a cancelled or aborted pump.
+                    self.active = Some(command);
+                    self.write_active(&record).await;
+                    if let Some(command) = self.active.take() { let _ = command.completed.send(()); }
+                }
+            }
+        }

+        self.commands.close();
+        while let Ok(command) = self.commands.try_recv() { let _ = command.completed.send(()); }

+        observation.writes = self.control.snapshots();

+impl Drop for Fixture {
+    fn drop(&mut self) {
+        let cleanup = self
+            .server
+            .as_mut()
+            .map(|server| server.stop(libc::SIGKILL, Duration::ZERO))
+            .transpose();
+        let clean = cleanup.is_ok() && TcpStream::connect(("127.0.0.1", self.port)).is_err();
+        // Capture before deleting the private installation, on failure too.
+        // Only the exporter's explicit public subset enters the log directory.
+        let originals = self.capture_originals();
+        let record = json!({"clean":clean,"joined":cleanup.as_ref().map(|_| true).unwrap_or(false),
+            "error":cleanup.err().map(|error| format!("{error:#}")),
+            "originals_retained":originals.is_ok(),
+            "originals_error":originals.as_ref().err().map(|error| format!("{error:#}"))});
+        let _ = fs::write(
+            self.logs().join("cleanup.json"),
+            serde_json::to_vec(&record).unwrap_or_default(),
+        );
+        if let Some(destination) = std::env::var_os("SHENKO_NATIVE_E1_EVIDENCE")
+            && let Err(error) = copy_diagnostics(&self.logs(), Path::new(&destination))
+        {
+            eprintln!("native E1 evidence copy failed: {error:#}");
+        }
+        if clean && originals.is_ok() && !self.logs().join("processes.cleanup-failed").exists() {
+            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(self.private());
+        }
+        eprintln!(
+            "native E1 original observations retained in {}",
+            self.logs().display()
+        );
+    }
+}

+fn latest(state: &parking_lot::Mutex<NativeT2AuthorityState>) -> Result<CommitAuthorityGrant> {
+    let state = state.lock();
+    state
+        .grants
+        .get(&state.last)
+        .cloned()
+        .context("original retained grant")

+//! One factual successor: the original attempt's first Unknown becomes definite.
+//!
+//! Codec 3 has an explicit first-E1 predecessor and requires its real local
+//! materialization. It carries no case decision, task transition or send permit.
+//! The original codec 1/2 reader remains the only E1 reader used by chosen T2.
+use rusqlite::{Connection, Transaction, params};
+use shenko_types::{
+    commit::CommitRef,
+    error::ShenkoError,
+    evidence::EvidenceReceipt,
+    ids::RecordRevision,
+    native_evidence::{NATIVE_EVIDENCE_CLOSURE_BYTES, NATIVE_EVIDENCE_CLOSURE_OBJECTS},
+    object::ObjectRef,
+    operation::{AttemptDispatchStage, AttemptRecord, EffectStatus, OperationRecord, OperationState},
+};
+
+use crate::{
+    Store,
+    arming_transition::NativeArmFacts,
+    native_evidence::{
+        CODEC, NativeEvidenceFact, NativeEvidenceFold, read_materialization, read_records,
+        record_materialization, verify_materialization, write_projection,
+    },
+    native_facts::{conflict, invalid, same},
+    store::storage_error,
+};
+
+fn first_unknown(operation: &OperationRecord, attempt: &AttemptRecord) -> bool {
+    operation.record_schema_version == 1
+        && attempt.record_schema_version == 1
+        && operation.record_revision == RecordRevision(1)
+        && operation.state == OperationState::Reconciling
+        && operation.outcome.is_none()
+        && !operation.outcome_conflict
+        && operation.effect_status == EffectStatus::Unknown
+        && operation.evidence_through.is_some()
+        && attempt.dispatch_stage == AttemptDispatchStage::Unknown
+        && attempt.final_receipt_id.is_some()
+}
+
+fn successor_scope(
+    conn: &Connection,
+    original: &NativeArmFacts,
+    expected_receipts: u64,
+) -> Result<(), ShenkoError> {
+    let counts: (u64, u64, u64) = conn.query_row(
+        "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM operations WHERE json_extract(data,'$.task_id')=?1),
+            (SELECT count(*) FROM attempts WHERE operation_id=?2),
+            (SELECT count(*) FROM evidence_receipts WHERE operation_id=?2)",
+        params![original.task.task_id.to_string(), original.operation.operation_id.to_string()],
+        |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?, row.get(2)?)),
+    ).map_err(storage_error)?;
+    if counts != (1, 1, expected_receipts)
+        || crate::native_facts::has_ordinary_children(conn, original.task.task_id)?
+    {
+        return Err(conflict(
+            "native E1 successor requires one original operation/attempt and no ordinary child",
+        ));
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+fn verify_first_receipt(
+    conn: &Connection,
+    reference: &ObjectRef,
+    first: &NativeEvidenceFact,
+) -> Result<(), ShenkoError> {
+    let marker = read_materialization(conn, first.receipt.receipt_id)?
+        .ok_or_else(|| conflict("successor E1 requires the first Unknown's actual local receipt"))?;
+    if marker.evidence_ref != *reference {
+        return Err(invalid("first-Unknown local receipt names a different original seal"));
+    }
+    verify_materialization(conn, &marker, first)
+}

+impl NativeEvidenceFact {
+    fn validate_successor(
+        &self,
+        predecessor_ref: &ObjectRef,
+        predecessor: &Self,
+    ) -> Result<(), ShenkoError> {
+        let fold = self.fold.ok_or_else(|| invalid("successor E1 omitted its original fold"))?;
+        let outcome = fold.outcome.ok_or_else(|| invalid("successor E1 is not definite"))?;
+        if self.schema_version != 3
+            || self.predecessor_ref.as_ref() != Some(predecessor_ref)
+            || predecessor.schema_version != 2
+            || !first_unknown(&predecessor.operation, &predecessor.attempt)
+            || !same(&self.arm, &predecessor.arm)?
+            || self.receipt.record_schema_version != 1
+            || self.receipt.receipt_id == predecessor.receipt.receipt_id
+            || self.receipt.operation_id != Some(predecessor.operation.operation_id)
+            || self.receipt.attempt_id != Some(predecessor.attempt.attempt_id)
+            || self.receipt.received_commit.seq.0 == 0
+            || (self.receipt.received_commit.ledger_id == predecessor.receipt.received_commit.ledger_id
+                && self.receipt.received_commit.seq <= predecessor.receipt.received_commit.seq)
+            || fold.effect == EffectStatus::Unknown
+            || fold.terminal_content_conflict
+            || fold.expected_revision.is_some_and(|revision| revision != RecordRevision(1))
+            || self.attempt.last_observed_at.is_none()
+            || chrono::NaiveDateTime::parse_from_str(&self.created_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S").is_err()
+        {
+            return Err(invalid("successor E1 changed its original first-Unknown causal predecessor"));
+        }
+        // The predecessor is independently validated from the original paired
+        // T1. Only the normal Unknown -> definite fold may follow it here.
+        let mut operation = predecessor.operation.clone();
+        let mut attempt = predecessor.attempt.clone();
+        operation.state = OperationState::Resolved;
+        operation.outcome = Some(outcome);
+        operation.effect_status = fold.effect;
+        operation.record_revision = RecordRevision(2);
+        operation.evidence_through = Some(self.receipt.received_commit);
+        attempt.dispatch_stage = AttemptDispatchStage::Ended;
+        attempt.final_receipt_id = Some(self.receipt.receipt_id);
+        attempt.last_observed_at = self.attempt.last_observed_at;
+        if !same(&operation, &self.operation)? || !same(&attempt, &self.attempt)? {
+            return Err(invalid("successor E1 rewrote the original operation, attempt or frozen fold"));
+        }
+        Ok(())
+    }
+}
