+impl Store {
+    /// This is a local fact check, not a source marker imported from CAS. A
+    /// successor closure alone must never install its missing first E1.
+    fn actual_first_unknown(
+        &self,
+        conn: &Connection,
+        reference: &ObjectRef,
+    ) -> Result<(NativeEvidenceFact, NativeArmFacts), ShenkoError> {
+        if reference.codec.major != 2 {
+            return Err(invalid("successor E1 must name a codec-2 first Unknown"));
+        }
+        let (first, original) = self.read_native_evidence_fact(conn, reference)?;
+        if !first_unknown(&first.operation, &first.attempt) {
+            return Err(invalid("successor E1 predecessor is not the first Unknown"));
+        }
+        verify_first_receipt(conn, reference, &first)?;
+        Ok((first, original))
+    }
+
+    pub(crate) fn try_seal_native_successor(
+        &self,
+        tx: &Transaction<'_>,
+        before: &(OperationRecord, AttemptRecord),
+        receipt: &EvidenceReceipt,
+        operation: &OperationRecord,
+        attempt: &AttemptRecord,
+        fold: NativeEvidenceFold,
+    ) -> Result<(), ShenkoError> {
+        if !first_unknown(&before.0, &before.1)
+            || receipt.record_schema_version != 1
+            || fold.outcome.is_none()
+            || fold.effect == EffectStatus::Unknown
+            || fold.terminal_content_conflict
+        {
+            return Ok(());
+        }
+        let Some(arm) = self.local_native_fact(tx, before.0.prepared_commit, "native.arm")? else {
+            return Ok(());
+        };
+        if arm.transition_ref.codec.major == 1 {
+            return Ok(());
+        }
+        let first_id = before.1.final_receipt_id
+            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("first Unknown omitted its original receipt"))?;
+        let marker = read_materialization(tx, first_id)?
+            .ok_or_else(|| conflict("later E1 retained without an actual first-Unknown application"))?;
+        let (first, original) = self.actual_first_unknown(tx, &marker.evidence_ref)?;
+        if !same(&arm, &first.arm)?
+            || !same(&before.0, &first.operation)?
+            || !same(&before.1, &first.attempt)?
+            || (marker.committed_at.ledger_id == receipt.received_commit.ledger_id
+                && marker.committed_at.seq >= receipt.received_commit.seq)
+        {
+            return Err(conflict("later E1 did not observe the locally materialized first Unknown"));
+        }
+        // The new receipt has already been admitted in this same transaction.
+        // Non-storage proof failures are retained as seal debt, never E1 loss.
+        successor_scope(tx, &original, 2)?;
+        let created_at = tx.query_row(
+            "SELECT created_at FROM evidence_receipts WHERE receipt_id=?1",
+            [receipt.receipt_id.to_string()], |row| row.get(0),
+        ).map_err(storage_error)?;
+        let fact = NativeEvidenceFact {
+            schema_version: 3,
+            arm,
+            receipt: receipt.clone(),
+            operation: operation.clone(),
+            attempt: attempt.clone(),
+            created_at,
+            fold: Some(fold),
+            predecessor_ref: Some(marker.evidence_ref.clone()),
+        };
+        fact.validate_successor(&marker.evidence_ref, &first)?;
+        self.seal_native_evidence_fact(tx, &fact)
+    }
+
+    /// Factual intake only. The T2 reader intentionally still rejects codec 3.
+    pub(crate) fn read_native_delivery_fact(
+        &self,
+        conn: &Connection,
+        reference: &ObjectRef,
+    ) -> Result<(NativeEvidenceFact, NativeArmFacts), ShenkoError> {
+        if reference.codec.major != 3 {
+            return self.read_native_evidence_fact(conn, reference);
+        }
+        let fact: NativeEvidenceFact = self.read_native_json(reference, CODEC, 3)?;
+        let predecessor_ref = fact.predecessor_ref.as_ref()
+            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("successor E1 omitted its causal predecessor"))?;
+        let (_, missing) = self.collect_closure_bounded(
+            std::slice::from_ref(reference),
+            NATIVE_EVIDENCE_CLOSURE_OBJECTS,
+            NATIVE_EVIDENCE_CLOSURE_BYTES,
+        ).map_err(invalid)?;
+        if !missing.is_empty() {
+            return Err(invalid("successor E1 closure is incomplete"));
+        }
+        let (first, original) = self.read_native_evidence_fact(conn, predecessor_ref)?;
+        fact.validate_successor(predecessor_ref, &first)?;
+        // Malformed typed bytes are rejected before a missing local first-E1
+        // receipt is classified as retryable predecessor debt.
+        verify_first_receipt(conn, predecessor_ref, &first)?;
+        Ok((fact, original))
+    }
+
+    /// Fresh factual application has no worker/dispatch result. Existing
+    /// materializations are handled by the delivery's non-rewinding replay path.
+    pub(crate) fn materialize_native_successor(
+        &self,
+        tx: &Transaction<'_>,
+        reference: &ObjectRef,
+        local: CommitRef,
+    ) -> Result<usize, ShenkoError> {
+        let (fact, original) = self.read_native_delivery_fact(tx, reference)?;
+        let predecessor_ref = fact.predecessor_ref.as_ref()
+            .ok_or_else(|| invalid("successor intake requires its causal predecessor"))?;
+        let (first, _) = self.actual_first_unknown(tx, predecessor_ref)?;
+        let current = read_records(tx, fact.operation.operation_id, fact.attempt.attempt_id)?;
+        if !same(&current.0, &first.operation)? || !same(&current.1, &first.attempt)? {
+            return Err(conflict("successor E1 cannot overwrite a different or later local observation"));
+        }
+        successor_scope(tx, &original, 1)?;
+        let has_case: bool = tx.query_row(
+            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reconciliation_cases WHERE operation_id=?1)",
+            [fact.operation.operation_id.to_string()], |row| row.get(0),
+        ).map_err(storage_error)?;
+        if !has_case || !matches!(
+            crate::receipt_admission::decide(tx, &fact.receipt).map_err(storage_error)?,
+            crate::receipt_admission::Admission::New
+        ) {
+            return Err(conflict("successor E1 lacks its local Unknown case or has conflicting receipt identity"));
+        }
+        write_projection(tx, &fact, local)?;
+        // This updates only an undecided local case, or appends a local
+        // resolution after an acknowledgement. No source decision is in E1.
+        let cases = self.resolve_unknown_effect_cases(
+            tx, fact.operation.operation_id, fact.receipt.receipt_id, local,
+        )?;
+        record_materialization(tx, reference, &fact, local)?;
+        Ok(4 + cases)
+    }

+//! Regressions for the smoke-admission defect: a candidate whose smoke
+//! report did not pass must never become activatable. `prepare` refuses it
+//! before any activation record exists, `activate` re-reads the sealed
+//! evidence before quiescing, and `rollback` smokes the retained executable
+//! under the same rule. In every refusal the working runtime's selector,
+//! generation and subject head are exactly what they were before.
+//!
+//! Contract basis — docs/specs/self-update.md: "`launch_smoke` actually
+//! executes the selected candidate artifact against its copy. A
+//! missing/malformed manifest, failed command or failed report is an
+//! error", and "the previous executable is smoke-launched again against
+//! that copy".
+
+use std::fs;
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+use std::sync::Arc;
+
+use shenko_types::ids::{BranchId, LedgerSeq};
+use shenko_types::subject::{GenesisRef, SubjectGenesis, SubjectStep, SubjectStepState};
+use shenko_types::task::{DispatchEligibility, TaskRecord};
+
+use super::*;
+
+/// An explicit local-installation authority: no committed node claim, a
+/// present local-branch binding, stable across every re-read so authority
+/// comparisons never fire inside these tests.
+struct FixtureAuthority;
+
+impl PrimaryClaimSource for FixtureAuthority {
+    fn committed_primary_claim(&self) -> Result<Option<PrimaryClaim>> {
+        Ok(None)
+    }
+
+    fn local_branch_authority(&self) -> Result<Option<serde_json::Value>> {
+        Ok(Some(serde_json::json!({ "local_installation": true })))
+    }
+}
+
+fn authority_json() -> serde_json::Value {
+    serde_json::json!({
+        "primary_claim": null,
+        "local_branch": { "local_installation": true },
+    })
+}
+
+/// One throwaway installation: a live slot with a real genesis store, the
+/// shared CAS, the committed genesis selector at revision 0 and the sealed
+/// route authority naming a real retained executable.
+struct Installation {
+    data_dir: PathBuf,
+    live_slot: PathBuf,
+    store: Arc<Store>,
+    service: UpdateService,
+    agent_id: EntityId,
+    generation: RuntimeGeneration,
+}
+
+impl Installation {
+    fn cleanup(self) {
+        let dir = self.data_dir.clone();
+        drop(self);
+        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(dir);
+    }
+}
+
+fn seal(store: &Store, value: &serde_json::Value) -> ObjectRef {
+    store
+        .cas
+        .seal_object(
+            &serde_json::to_vec(value).unwrap(),
+            "application/json",
+            "test",
+            "json",
+            1,
+        )
+        .unwrap()
+        .object
+}
+
+fn state_copy_json(slot_dir: &Path, generation: &RuntimeGeneration) -> serde_json::Value {
+    serde_json::json!({
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "generation": generation.0,
+        "slot_dir": slot_dir.to_string_lossy(),
+        "db_path": slot_dir.join(SLOT_DB_FILENAME).to_string_lossy(),
+        "watermark": null,
+    })
+}
+
+fn installation() -> Installation {
+    let data_dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("shenko-update-smoke-{}", EntityId::new()));
+    // The live slot sits where the launcher layout allows one and is named
+    // by the installation's current-slot pointer, as in a real install.
+    let live_slot = data_dir.join("versions").join("live");
+    fs::create_dir_all(&live_slot).unwrap();
+    let cas_dir = data_dir.join("cas");
+    let store = Arc::new(Store::open(live_slot.join(SLOT_DB_FILENAME), cas_dir).unwrap());
+    slots::publish_current_slot(&data_dir, &live_slot).unwrap();
+    let ledger_id = store.ledger.ledger_id();
+    let generation = RuntimeGeneration::default();
+
+    // The retained executable of the genesis generation: a real program that
+    // answers the bounded smoke command for this generation, so a rollback
+    // can smoke-launch the retained closure exactly like a forward candidate.
+    let executable = write_executable(&data_dir, "shenko-program", &smoke_script(&generation.0));
+
+    let agent_id = EntityId::new();
+    let genesis_id = EntityId::new();
+    let installation_id = EntityId::new();
+    let seed_manifest = seal(
+        &store,
+        &serde_json::json!({ "kind": "seed_manifest", "complete_product_seed": false }),
+    );
+    let genesis = SubjectGenesis {
+        genesis_id,
+        subject_id: agent_id,
+        bootstrap_id: EntityId::new(),
+        launch_id: EntityId::new(),
+        seed_manifest_ref: seed_manifest.clone(),
+        initial_profile_ref: seal(&store, &serde_json::json!({ "kind": "model_profile" })),
+        home_manifest_ref: seal(&store, &serde_json::json!({ "kind": "home" })),
+        bootstrap_event_ref: seal(
+            &store,
+            &serde_json::json!({
+                "event": "bootstrap",
+                "kind": "genesis",
+                "installation_id": installation_id,
+                "seed_manifest_ref": seed_manifest,
+            }),
+        ),
+        created_commit: CommitRef::new(ledger_id, LedgerSeq(0)),
+    };
+    let first_step_id = EntityId::new();
+    let head = SubjectBranchHead { branch_origin: None,
+        agent_id,
+        branch_id: BranchId::new(),
+        subject_root_task_id: EntityId::new(),
+        controller_epoch: ControllerEpoch(1),
+        software_generation: generation.clone(),
+        genesis_ref: GenesisRef { ledger_id, genesis_id },
+        committed_step_no: 0,
+        committed_step_id: None,
+        committed_at: CommitRef::new(ledger_id, LedgerSeq(0)),
+        next_step_id: first_step_id,
+        mode: SubjectMode::Active,
+        mode_reason_ref: None,
+        record_revision: RecordRevision(0),
+    };
+    let first_step = SubjectStep {
+        step_id: first_step_id,
+        branch_id: head.branch_id.clone(),
+        step_no: 1,
+        expected_parent_commit: genesis.created_commit,
+        controller_epoch: ControllerEpoch(1),
+        software_generation: generation.clone(),
+        state: SubjectStepState::Planned,
+        input_plan_ref: None,
+        context_revision: None,
+        active_request_id: None,
+        active_attempt_id: None,
+        model_result_ref: None,
+        model_outcome_ref: None,
+        decision_ref: None,
+        commit_ref: None,
+        retry_reason_ref: None,
+        record_revision: RecordRevision(0),
+        created_by_step_id: None,
+    };
+    let state_ref = seal(&store, &state_copy_json(&live_slot, &generation));
+    let route_ref = seal(
+        &store,
+        &serde_json::to_value(RouteAuthority {
+            schema_version: RouteAuthority::SCHEMA_VERSION,
+            agent_id,
+            generation: generation.clone(),
+            active_epoch: 1,
+            selector_revision: 0,
+            data_dir: data_dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
+            slot_dir: live_slot.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
+            artifact_path: executable.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
+            artifact_digest: Digest::blake3(&fs::read(&executable).unwrap()),
+            launch_command: vec![
+                executable.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
+                "--data-dir".to_string(),
+                data_dir.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
+                "start".to_string(),
+            ],
+            primary_claim: None,
+            activation_id: None,
+        })
+        .unwrap(),
+    );
+    let selector = ActivationSelector {
+        agent_id,
+        selector_revision: 0,
+        active_epoch: 1,
+        generation: generation.clone(),
+        state_ref,
+        origin: ActivationOrigin::Genesis {
+            genesis_ref: GenesisRef { ledger_id, genesis_id },
+        },
+        route_authority_ref: route_ref,
+    };
+    let mut root_task = TaskRecord::subject_root(
+        head.subject_root_task_id,
+        agent_id,
+        seed_manifest,
+        genesis.created_commit,
+    );
+    // The delta importer keeps imported work parked and marks it; a copied
+    // store whose root task differs from that shape trips the task-closure
+    // conflict rule even when the rows are byte-identical. Model the state
+    // an installation that already passed one handover carries — the same
+    // task identity, parked and marked, so the catch-up reads it as its own
+    // earlier delivery rather than a conflicting peer graft.
+    root_task.dispatch_eligibility = DispatchEligibility::Parked {
+        reason_ref: root_task.task_id,
+        until_utc: None,
+    };
+    root_task.memos.insert(
+        "cognition_imported".to_string(),
+        serde_json::json!({ "note": "imported work is parked on the receiving store" }),
+    );
+    store
+        .initialize_genesis_with(&genesis, &head, &first_step, &root_task, Some(&selector))
+        .unwrap();
+
+    let service = UpdateService::new(
+        data_dir.clone(),
+        live_slot.clone(),
+        store.clone(),
+        Arc::new(HandoffParticipantRegistry::for_exclusively_owned_stopped_installation()),
+        Arc::new(crate::build::CargoBuildProvider::default()),
+    )
+    .with_claim_source(Arc::new(FixtureAuthority));
+    Installation {
+        data_dir,
+        live_slot,
+        store,
+        service,
+        agent_id,
+        generation,
+    }
+}
+
+/// The working runtime is still the committed genesis generation: the
+/// selector never moved and the subject head is active and unpaused.
+fn assert_working_runtime_intact(fixture: &Installation) {
+    let selector = fixture
+        .store
+        .activation_selector(fixture.agent_id)
+        .unwrap()
+        .expect("the committed selector must still exist");
+    assert_eq!(selector.selector_revision, 0);
+    assert_eq!(selector.generation, fixture.generation);
+    let (head, _) = fixture.store.load_subject(fixture.agent_id).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(head.mode, SubjectMode::Active);
+    assert_eq!(head.software_generation, fixture.generation);
+}

+/// The canonical candidate slot directory for a generation, exactly where

+}

+        to_state_ref: seal(&fixture.store, &state_copy_json(to_slot, to_generation)),
+        migrator_ref: delta_migrator_ref(),

+fn smoke_report(
+    generation: &RuntimeGeneration,
+    passed: bool,
+    exit_code: i32,
+    checks: Vec<smoke::SmokeCheckOutcome>,
+) -> SmokeReport {
+    SmokeReport {
+        schema_version: smoke::SMOKE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        generation: generation.0.clone(),
+        checks,
+        passed,
+        exit_code,
+        stdout_tail: String::new(),
+        stderr_tail: String::new(),
+        launched_at: "2026-11-02T00:00:00Z".to_string(),
+    }
+}
+
+fn write_executable(dir: &Path, name: &str, script: &str) -> PathBuf {
+    let path = dir.join(name);
+    fs::write(&path, script).unwrap();
+    #[cfg(unix)]
+    {
+        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
+        let mut permissions = fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().permissions();
+        permissions.set_mode(0o755);
+        fs::set_permissions(&path, permissions).unwrap();
+    }
+    path
+}
+
+/// A real program that answers the bounded candidate smoke command for one
+/// generation: it prints the report the candidate itself would print and
+/// exits zero. It never drives a subject or sends an outbox message.
+fn smoke_script(generation: &str) -> String {
+    let report = serde_json::json!({
+        "schema_version": smoke::SMOKE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
+        "generation": generation,
+        "checks": [{ "name": "state_copy", "passed": true, "detail": null }],
+        "passed": true,
+        "exit_code": 0,
+        "stdout_tail": "",
+        "stderr_tail": "",
+        "launched_at": "2026-11-02T00:00:00Z",
+    });
+    format!("#!/bin/sh\ncat <<'SHENKO_SMOKE_EOF'\n{report}\nSHENKO_SMOKE_EOF\nexit 0\n")
+}

+/// A failed smoke outcome — non-zero exit, no usable report, or an
+/// explicit `passed: false` — refuses the prepare before an activation
+/// record exists. A missing report is never treated as a pass and a failed
+/// report is never fabricated into one.
+#[tokio::test]
+#[cfg(unix)]
+async fn prepare_refuses_a_candidate_whose_smoke_did_not_pass() {
+    let fixture = installation();
+    let failed_report = serde_json::to_string(&smoke_report(
+        &RuntimeGeneration::new("gen-failed-report"),
+        false,
+        0,
+        vec![smoke::SmokeCheckOutcome {
+            name: "state_copy".to_string(),
+            passed: false,
+            detail: Some("the candidate state copy did not open".to_string()),
+        }],
+    ))
+    .unwrap();
+    let report_path = fixture.data_dir.join("failed-report.json");
+    fs::write(&report_path, &failed_report).unwrap();
+    let cases: Vec<(&str, String, &str)> = vec![
+        (
+            "nonzero-exit-no-report",
+            "#!/bin/sh\nexit 3\n".to_string(),
+            "exit code 3",
+        ),
+        (
+            "unreadable-report",
+            "#!/bin/sh\necho not-a-report\nexit 0\n".to_string(),
+            "did not print a readable smoke report",
+        ),
+        (
+            "failed-report",

+/// The live activate/rollback path freezes its request, pauses the subject and
+/// hands the final catch-up and the selector CAS to a finite helper. If that
+/// helper dies before the CAS, nobody on the old side knows the private request
+/// id any more. The next owner of the installation takes the boundary back as
+/// the *same* controller generation — no new controller epoch, no second
+/// primary, no replayed operation — and keeps the abandoned activation and its
+/// stopped-resource receipts as evidence.
+#[tokio::test]
+async fn reconcile_resumes_the_same_controller_after_an_interrupted_handoff() {
+    let fixture = installation();
+    let target = RuntimeGeneration::new("gen-b");
+    let request_id = EntityId::new();
+    fixture
+        .store
+        .request_subject_quiesce(fixture.agent_id, request_id)
+        .unwrap();
+    let (head, _) = fixture.store.load_subject(fixture.agent_id).unwrap();
+    let paused = fixture
+        .store
+        .pause_subject_at_boundary(&head)
+        .unwrap()
+        .expect("the clean boundary must pause");
+    assert_eq!(paused.mode, SubjectMode::Paused);
+
+    // The frozen live-control request exactly as the control transport seals
+    // it, and the activation record that names it.
+    let installation_id = fixture
+        .store
+        .installation_id_for_subject(fixture.agent_id)
+        .unwrap();
+    let selected = fixture
+        .store
+        .activation_selector(fixture.agent_id)
+        .unwrap()
+        .unwrap();
+    let frozen = seal(
+        &fixture.store,
+        &serde_json::json!({
+            "schema_version": 1,
+            "request_id": request_id,
+            "agent_id": fixture.agent_id,
+            "installation_id": installation_id,
+            "command": { "Activate": { "activation": EntityId::new(), "expected_selector_revision": 0 } },
+            "source_selector": selected,
+            "source_slot": fixture.live_slot,
+            "helper_digest": Digest::blake3(b"helper executable"),
+        }),
+    );
+    let mut record = activation_record(
+        &fixture,
+        &fixture.generation,
+        &target,
+        &fixture.live_slot,
+        &candidate_slot(&fixture, &target),
+        ActivationPhase::Handoff,
+        None,
+    );
+    record.recovery_closure_ref = seal(
+        &fixture.store,
+        &serde_json::json!({
+            "schema_version": 1,
+            "authority": authority_json(),
+            "process_handoff_request_ref": frozen,
+        }),
+    );
+    // What the old process actually stopped before it died: debt evidence that
+    // must survive the abandonment unchanged.
+    record.pending_operations_ref = Some(seal(
+        &fixture.store,
+        &serde_json::json!({
+            "receipts": [
+                { "participant": "native-children", "stopped": [] },
+                { "participant": "playground-services", "stopped": ["4242:1:digest"] },
+            ],
+        }),
+    ));
+    let record = fixture.store.create_activation_record(&record).unwrap();
+
+    let answer = fixture
+        .service
+        .reconcile_interrupted_handoff(fixture.agent_id)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(
+        answer.state,
+        HandoffReconciliationState::ResumedSameController,
+        "an uncommitted hand-over must be taken back, not abandoned: {answer:?}"
+    );
+    assert!(answer.resumed);
+    assert_eq!(answer.request_id, Some(request_id));
+    assert_eq!(answer.activation_id, Some(record.activation_id));
+    assert_eq!(answer.activation_phase, Some(ActivationPhase::Abandoned));
+    assert!(answer.receipt_ref.is_some(), "the answer is a sealed fact");
+
+    let (head, step) = fixture.store.load_subject(fixture.agent_id).unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(head.mode, SubjectMode::Active);
+    assert_eq!(
+        head.controller_epoch,
+        ControllerEpoch(1),
+        "resuming the same controller never advances the epoch"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(head.software_generation, fixture.generation);
+    assert_eq!(
+        step.state,
+        SubjectStepState::Planned,
+        "the planned successor is preserved for the real loop"
+    );
+
+    let boundary = fixture.store.subject_quiesce(request_id).unwrap().unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(boundary.state, SubjectQuiesceState::Resumed);
+    assert_eq!(boundary.generation, fixture.generation);
+    assert_eq!(boundary.epoch, ControllerEpoch(1));
+
+    let abandoned = fixture
+        .store
+        .activation_record(record.activation_id)
+        .unwrap()
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(abandoned.phase, ActivationPhase::Abandoned);
+    assert_eq!(
+        abandoned.pending_operations_ref, record.pending_operations_ref,
+        "the stopped-resource receipts must survive the abandonment"
+    );
+    assert!(abandoned.last_error_ref.is_some());
+    assert_working_runtime_intact(&fixture);
+
+    // A second cold start finds nothing left to do and changes nothing.
+    let again = fixture
+        .service
+        .reconcile_interrupted_handoff(fixture.agent_id)
+        .unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(again.state, HandoffReconciliationState::NothingToDo);
+    assert!(!again.resumed);
+    fixture.cleanup();
+}

+        if data["kind"] != "update_prepare" { continue; }
+        let reference: ObjectRef = serde_json::from_value(data["extra"]["build_receipt_ref"].clone())?;

+//! requests. The stream gate delays/fails a real I/O boundary; it never
+//! supplies an application response, channel observation, or receipt.

+use crate::native_transport::stream::{CloseGuard, owned};
+use crate::seat::{
+    AnswerConfirmation, SeatAdapter, SeatAdapterId, SeatHandle, SeatWriteFence,

+    time::Duration,

+    io::{AsyncRead, AsyncWrite, DuplexStream, ReadBuf, duplex},

+const WAIT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);
+const ORIGINAL_ERROR: &str = "fixture original underlying PTY flush error";
+const OUTPUT_MARKER: &str = "PTY-FIXTURE-OUTPUT-COMPLETE";
+
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
+enum GateMode { Pass, HoldWrite, HoldFlush, FailFlush }
+
+#[derive(Default, Clone, Serialize)]
+struct IoObservation {
+    write_polls: u64,
+    bytes_written: u64,
+    flush_polls: u64,
+    flushes_completed: u64,
+    blocked_writes: u64,
+    blocked_flushes: u64,
+}
+
+struct GateState { mode: GateMode, observation: IoObservation, wake: Option<Waker> }
+
+#[derive(Clone)]
+struct Gate { state: Arc<Mutex<GateState>>, changed: Arc<Notify> }
+
+impl Gate {
+    fn new() -> Self {
+        Self {
+            state: Arc::new(Mutex::new(GateState {
+                mode: GateMode::Pass, observation: IoObservation::default(), wake: None,
+            })), changed: Arc::new(Notify::new()),
+        }
+    }
+    fn set(&self, mode: GateMode) {
+        let wake = {
+            let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+            state.mode = mode;
+            state.wake.take()
+        };
+        if let Some(wake) = wake { wake.wake(); }
+    }
+    fn observation(&self) -> IoObservation {
+        self.state.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).observation.clone()
+    }
+    async fn blocked(&self, mode: GateMode) {
+        loop {
+            let changed = self.changed.notified();
+            let observed = self.observation();
+            if (mode == GateMode::HoldWrite && observed.blocked_writes != 0)
+                || (mode == GateMode::HoldFlush && observed.blocked_flushes != 0) { return; }
+            changed.await;
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+struct GatedStream { inner: DuplexStream, gate: Gate }
+
+impl AsyncRead for GatedStream {
+    fn poll_read(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>, buf: &mut ReadBuf<'_>)
+        -> Poll<io::Result<()>>
+    { Pin::new(&mut self.inner).poll_read(cx, buf) }
+}
+
+impl AsyncWrite for GatedStream {
+    fn poll_write(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>, buf: &[u8])
+        -> Poll<io::Result<usize>>
+    {
+        {
+            let mut state = self.gate.state.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+            state.observation.write_polls += 1;
+            if state.mode == GateMode::HoldWrite {
+                state.observation.blocked_writes += 1;
+                state.wake = Some(cx.waker().clone());
+                self.gate.changed.notify_one();
+                return Poll::Pending;
+            }
+        }
+        let result = Pin::new(&mut self.inner).poll_write(cx, buf);
+        if let Poll::Ready(Ok(bytes)) = &result {
+            self.gate.state.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner())
+                .observation.bytes_written += *bytes as u64;
+        }
+        result
+    }
+
+    fn poll_flush(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
+        {
+            let mut state = self.gate.state.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
+            state.observation.flush_polls += 1;
+            match state.mode {
+                GateMode::HoldFlush => {
+                    state.observation.blocked_flushes += 1;
+                    state.wake = Some(cx.waker().clone());
+                    self.gate.changed.notify_one();
+                    return Poll::Pending;
+                }
+                GateMode::FailFlush => return Poll::Ready(Err(io::Error::other(ORIGINAL_ERROR))),
+                _ => {}
+            }
+        }
+        let result = Pin::new(&mut self.inner).poll_flush(cx);
+        if let Poll::Ready(Ok(())) = &result {
+            self.gate.state.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner())
+                .observation.flushes_completed += 1;
+        }
+        result
+    }
+
+    fn poll_shutdown(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
+        Pin::new(&mut self.inner).poll_shutdown(cx)
+    }
+}

+    async fn auth_publickey(&mut self, user: &str, verified: server::VerifiedPublicKey<'_>)

+        self.received.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).public_key_authentications += 1;

+    async fn channel_open_session(&mut self, channel: Channel<server::Msg>, reply: server::ChannelOpenHandle,

+        *self.channel_id.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()) = Some(channel.id());

+    async fn exec_request(&mut self, channel: ChannelId, command: &[u8], session: &mut server::Session)
+        -> Result<(), Self::Error>
+    {
+        if command != b"fixture-command" { return Err(russh::Error::Disconnect); }
+        session.channel_success(channel)?;
+        let channel = self.channel.take().ok_or(russh::Error::Disconnect)?;
+        let received = Arc::clone(&self.received);
+        let changed = Arc::clone(&self.changed);
+        let output = self.output;
+        let worker = tokio::spawn(async move {
+            let (mut read, write) = channel.split();
+            let receive = async {
+                while let Some(message) = read.wait().await {
+                    match message {
+                        ChannelMsg::Data { data } => {
+                            received.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).input.extend_from_slice(&data);
+                            changed.notify_one();
+                        }
+                        ChannelMsg::Close => break,
+                        _ => {}
+                    }
+                }
+            };
+            let send = async {
+                if output {
+                    let mut bytes = vec![b'o'; 128 * 1024];
+                    let ending = format!("\r\n{OUTPUT_MARKER}\r\n");
+                    let start = bytes.len() - ending.len();
+                    bytes[start..].copy_from_slice(ending.as_bytes());
+                    write.data(&bytes[..]).await?;
+                }
+                Ok::<(), russh::Error>(())
+            };
+            let ((), sent) = tokio::join!(receive, send);
+            sent?;
+            Ok(())
+        });
+        self.workers.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).push(worker);
+        Ok(())
+    }
+    async fn signal(&mut self, _channel: ChannelId, signal: Sig, _: &mut server::Session)
+        -> Result<(), Self::Error>
+    {
+        self.received.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).signals.push(format!("{signal:?}"));
+        self.changed.notify_one();
+        Ok(())
+    }
+}

+enum ProtocolEnd {
+    SetupFailed(String),
+    Joined { result: String, join_failed: bool },
+}
+
+struct ProtocolOwner {
+    observer: Option<JoinHandle<ProtocolEnd>>,
+    close: CloseGuard,
+}
+
+impl Drop for ProtocolOwner {
+    fn drop(&mut self) {
+        self.close.close();
+        // Last-resort observer abort is not a protocol-session join receipt.
+        // Any such missing receipt remains an explicit cleanup failure below.
+        if let Some(observer) = &self.observer { observer.abort(); }
+    }
+}
+
+struct WorkerOwners(Vec<Worker>);
+
+impl Drop for WorkerOwners {
+    fn drop(&mut self) { for worker in &self.0 { worker.abort(); } }
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Default, Serialize)]
+struct Cleanup {
+    protocol_end_observed: bool,
+    observer_results: Vec<String>,
+    worker_results: Vec<String>,
+    failures: Vec<String>,
+}
+
+async fn observe_protocol(owner: &mut ProtocolOwner, report: &mut Cleanup) {
+    if let Some(observer) = owner.observer.as_mut() {
+        match timeout(WAIT, &mut *observer).await {
+            Ok(Ok(ProtocolEnd::Joined { result, join_failed })) => {
+                // The original observer has actually awaited RunningSession.
+                // A normal Err is an observed protocol end, not remote success.
+                report.protocol_end_observed = true;
+                report.observer_results.push(format!("original running session completed: {result}"));
+                if join_failed { report.failures.push(format!("original protocol task join failed: {result}")); }
+                drop(owner.observer.take());
+            }
+            Ok(Ok(ProtocolEnd::SetupFailed(error))) => {
+                report.observer_results.push(format!("original server did not create a running session: {error}"));
+                report.failures.push(format!("server protocol setup failed: {error}"));
+                drop(owner.observer.take());
+            }
+            Ok(Err(error)) => {
+                report.failures.push(format!("server observer joined without a protocol result: {error}"));
+                report.observer_results.push(format!("observer join: {error}"));
+                drop(owner.observer.take());
+            }
+            Err(error) => {
+                report.failures.push(format!("server protocol end not observed within stop budget: {error}"));
+                report.observer_results.push("original session join remains unknown".into());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+async fn cleanup(owner: &mut ProtocolOwner, workers: &Arc<Mutex<Vec<Worker>>>) -> Cleanup {
+    // Stop the actual server stream before awaiting its observer. Aborting the
+    // outer task alone would only drop RunningSession's inner JoinHandle.
+    owner.close.close();
+    let mut report = Cleanup::default();
+    observe_protocol(owner, &mut report).await;
+    let mut workers = WorkerOwners(std::mem::take(&mut *workers.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner())));
+    for worker in &mut workers.0 {
+        match timeout(WAIT, &mut *worker).await {
+            Ok(Ok(Ok(()))) => report.worker_results.push("original reader/output worker joined".into()),
+            Ok(result) => {
+                report.worker_results.push(format!("original reader/output worker result: {result:?}"));
+                report.failures.push(format!("peer reader/output worker: {result:?}"));
+            }
+            Err(error) => {
+                worker.abort();
+                let joined = timeout(WAIT, &mut *worker).await;
+                report.worker_results.push(format!("original worker stop timeout; abort join={joined:?}"));
+                report.failures.push(format!("peer worker timeout: {error}; abort join={joined:?}"));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    // If draining/stopping a reader was needed, still await the same original
+    // session. A prior timeout is retained even if this later join completes.
+    if owner.observer.is_some() { observe_protocol(owner, &mut report).await; }
+    report
+}

+struct Fixture {
+    protocol: ProtocolOwner,
+    handle: server::Handle,
+    channel_id: Arc<Mutex<Option<ChannelId>>>,
+    received: Arc<Mutex<Received>>,
+    changed: Arc<Notify>,
+    workers: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Worker>>>,
+    gate: Gate,
+}
+
+impl Fixture {
+    async fn open(output: bool) -> Result<(Self, NativePtySession)> {
+        let (client_io, server_io) = duplex(1024);
+        let (server_io, server_close) = owned(server_io);
+        let received = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Received::default()));
+        let changed = Arc::new(Notify::new());
+        let workers = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
+        let channel_id = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
+        let gate = Gate::new();
+        let peer = Peer {
+            expected: key(22).public_key().clone(), channel: None, channel_id: Arc::clone(&channel_id),
+            received: Arc::clone(&received), changed: Arc::clone(&changed), workers: Arc::clone(&workers), output,
+        };
+        let config = Arc::new(server::Config {
+            keys: vec![key(11)], window_size: 64 * 1024, maximum_packet_size: 32 * 1024,
+            channel_buffer_size: 4, event_buffer_size: 4, auth_rejection_time: Duration::ZERO,
+            auth_rejection_time_initial: Some(Duration::ZERO), inactivity_timeout: Some(Duration::from_secs(15)),
+            ..Default::default()
+        });
+        let (started, ready) = oneshot::channel();
+        let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
+            let running = match server::run_stream(config, server_io, peer).await {
+                Ok(running) => running,
+                Err(error) => return ProtocolEnd::SetupFailed(format!("{error:?}")),
+            };
+            let _ = started.send(running.handle());
+            let result = running.await;
+            ProtocolEnd::Joined {
+                join_failed: matches!(&result, Err(russh::Error::Join(_))),
+                result: format!("{result:?}"),
+            }
+        });
+        let mut protocol = ProtocolOwner { observer: Some(server), close: server_close };
+        let opened: Result<_> = async {
+            let connection = NativeSshConnection::connect_stream(target(key(11).public_key(), false),
+                GatedStream { inner: client_io, gate: gate.clone() }, WAIT).await?;
+            let handle = timeout(WAIT, ready).await??;
+            let authenticated = connection.authenticate_private_key(
+                PrivateKeyWithHashAlg::new(Arc::new(key(22)), None)).await?;
+            let session = authenticated.open_pty(NativePtyRequest {
+                term: "xterm".into(), cols: 80, rows: 24,
+                program: NativePtyProgram::Exec { command: b"fixture-command".to_vec() },
+            }, WAIT).await?;
+            Ok((handle, session))
+        }.await;
+        let (handle, session) = match opened {
+            Ok(opened) => opened,
+            Err(error) => {
+                let stopped = cleanup(&mut protocol, &workers).await;
+                eprintln!("PTY original setup failure: {error:#}");
+                eprintln!("PTY setup cleanup: {}", serde_json::to_string(&stopped)?);
+                return Err(error.context(format!("fixture setup failed; original cleanup={stopped:?}")));
+            }
+        };
+        Ok((Self { protocol, handle, channel_id, received, changed, workers, gate }, session))
+    }
+
+    async fn observed(&self, condition: impl Fn(&Received) -> bool) -> Result<()> {
+        timeout(WAIT, async {
+            loop {
+                let changed = self.changed.notified();
+                if condition(&self.received.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner())) { return; }
+                changed.await;
+            }
+        }).await.context("original peer observation deadline")
+    }
+
+    async fn close_channel(&self) -> Result<()> {
+        let channel = self.channel_id.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner())
+            .context("fixture channel was not established")?;
+        timeout(WAIT, self.handle.close(channel)).await?
+            .map_err(|()| anyhow::anyhow!("peer channel close could not be queued"))
+    }
+
+    async fn finish(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
+        let stopped = cleanup(&mut self.protocol, &self.workers).await;
+        eprintln!("PTY original protocol/worker cleanup: {}", serde_json::to_string(&stopped)?);
+        eprintln!("PTY original peer data: {}", serde_json::to_string(&*self.received.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()))?);
+        eprintln!("PTY underlying I/O observation: {}", serde_json::to_string(&self.gate.observation())?);
+        anyhow::ensure!(stopped.protocol_end_observed && stopped.failures.is_empty(), "original cleanup failed: {stopped:?}");
+        Ok(())
+    }
+}
+
+impl Drop for Fixture {
+    fn drop(&mut self) {
+        self.protocol.close.close();
+        for worker in self.workers.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).iter() { worker.abort(); }
+    }
+}

+fn seat_handle() -> SeatHandle {

+        location_id: "fixture-pty-flush".into(), adapter: SeatAdapterId::SshPty,

+        cwd: None, remote_session_id: None, current_command: None, process_identity: None,

+fn fence() -> SeatWriteFence {

+        seat_id: EntityId::new(), seat_incarnation: SeatIncarnation(1), task_id: EntityId::new(),
+        task_revision: TaskRevision(1), question_id: EntityId::new(), question_revision: 1,

+async fn reach_gate<F: Future>(future: Pin<&mut F>, gate: &Gate, mode: GateMode) -> Result<()>
+where F::Output: std::fmt::Debug
+{
+    timeout(WAIT, async {
+        tokio::select! {
+            result = future => Err(anyhow::anyhow!("input completed before its held underlying boundary: {result:?}")),
+            () = gate.blocked(mode) => Ok(()),
+        }
+    }).await?
+}

+async fn close_seat(fixture: &mut Fixture, seat: &SshPtySeat) -> Result<NativePtyObservation> {
+    let close = timeout(Duration::from_secs(12), seat.close()).await;
+    eprintln!("PTY original retained writes: {}", serde_json::to_string(&seat.write_observations())?);
+    eprintln!("PTY original close result: {close:?}");
+    let stopped = fixture.finish().await;
+    let observation = close??;
+    stopped?;
+    anyhow::ensure!(observation.session_end_observed);
+    Ok(observation)
+}

+#[test]
+fn original_pty_writes_observe_flush_cancel_errors_and_channel_loss() -> Result<()> {
+    tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().enable_all().build()?.block_on(async {
+        // 1. The actual first data flush is held. More than both SSH windows
+        // flows in both directions once released, and submit's CR is retained.
+        // 2. INT is a later same-FIFO command, never an application acceptance.
+        let (mut fixture, session) = Fixture::open(true).await?;
+        let seat = SshPtySeat::spawn(session, seat_handle(), 80, 24);
+        let checked: Result<()> = async {
+            let handle = seat_handle();
+            let fence = fence();
+            let text = "i".repeat(128 * 1024);
+            let mut expected = text.as_bytes().to_vec();
+            expected.push(b'\r');
+            fixture.gate.set(GateMode::HoldFlush);
+            let before = fixture.gate.observation();
+            let mut pending = Box::pin(seat.submit(&handle, &text, &fence));
+            reach_gate(pending.as_mut(), &fixture.gate, GateMode::HoldFlush).await?;
+            // Incoming output can cause an earlier real WINDOW_ADJUST flush
+            // to reach the same gate. Also observe the original command's
+            // own admission to the physical writer before asserting its state.
+            timeout(WAIT, async {
+                loop {
+                    if seat.write_observations().first()
+                        .is_some_and(|record| record.state == NativePtyWriteState::Writing) { break; }
+                    tokio::task::yield_now().await;
+                }
+            }).await?;
+            let records = seat.write_observations();
+            anyhow::ensure!(records.len() == 1 && records[0].state == NativePtyWriteState::Writing);
+            anyhow::ensure!(records[0].input == NativePtyWriteInput::Data { bytes: expected.clone() });
+            anyhow::ensure!(fixture.gate.observation().flushes_completed == before.flushes_completed);
+            fixture.gate.set(GateMode::Pass);
+            let response = timeout(WAIT, pending).await??;
+            anyhow::ensure!(response.confirmation == AnswerConfirmation::Unconfirmed);
+            let detail: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(response.detail.as_deref().context("missing original data receipt")?)?;
+            anyhow::ensure!(detail["state"] == "locally_flushed");
+            anyhow::ensure!(detail["input"]["bytes"] == serde_json::to_value(&expected)?);
+            fixture.observed(|received| received.input == expected).await?;
+            // Peer input completion does not prove reverse-direction output
+            // completion. Observe the actual last output bytes in the original
+            // screen before close can remove the SSH channel and reject late data.
+            timeout(WAIT, async {
+                loop {
+                    if seat.screen().lock().await.grid().trimmed_text().contains(OUTPUT_MARKER) { break; }
+                    tokio::task::yield_now().await;
+                }
+            }).await?;
+            eprintln!("PTY first actual flush receipt: {}", response.detail.context("lost data receipt")?);
+            let signal = timeout(WAIT, seat.interrupt(&handle, &fence)).await??;
+            anyhow::ensure!(signal.confirmation == AnswerConfirmation::Unconfirmed);
+            fixture.observed(|received| received.signals == ["INT"] && received.input == expected).await?;
+            let receipt = seat.write_observations();
+            anyhow::ensure!(receipt.len() == 1 && receipt[0].state == NativePtyWriteState::LocallyFlushed);
+            anyhow::ensure!(receipt[0].input == NativePtyWriteInput::SignalInt && receipt[0].writer_epoch == 7);
+            anyhow::ensure!(fixture.received.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).public_key_authentications == 1);
+            Ok(())
+        }.await;
+        let closed = close_seat(&mut fixture, &seat).await;
+        checked?;
+        anyhow::ensure!(closed?.output_bytes == 128 * 1024, "full duplex output was not observed");
+
+        // 3. Cancel the original write at a real blocked I/O poll. A second
+        // admitted command never starts; opening the gate cannot revive either.
+        let (mut fixture, session) = Fixture::open(false).await?;
+        let seat = SshPtySeat::spawn(session, seat_handle(), 80, 24);
+        let checked: Result<()> = async {
+            let handle = seat_handle();
+            let fence = fence();
+            fixture.gate.set(GateMode::HoldWrite);
+            let mut original = Box::pin(seat.submit(&handle, "original-cancelled", &fence));
+            reach_gate(original.as_mut(), &fixture.gate, GateMode::HoldWrite).await?;
+            let original_id = seat.write_observations().first().context("original command missing")?.write_id;
+            let mut queued = Box::pin(seat.submit(&handle, "queued-never-sent", &fence));
+            let pending = std::future::poll_fn(|cx| Poll::Ready(queued.as_mut().poll(cx).is_pending())).await;
+            anyhow::ensure!(pending && seat.write_observations().len() == 2);
+            let at_cancel = fixture.gate.observation();
+            drop(original);
+            fixture.gate.set(GateMode::Pass);
+            let refused = timeout(WAIT, queued).await??;
+            anyhow::ensure!(matches!(refused.confirmation, AnswerConfirmation::NotSent { .. }));
+            let records = seat.write_observations();
+            let original = records.iter().find(|record| record.write_id == original_id).context("cancelled original lost")?;
+            anyhow::ensure!(original.state == NativePtyWriteState::Unknown && original.local_stream_closed);
+            anyhow::ensure!(original.input == NativePtyWriteInput::Data { bytes: b"original-cancelled\r".to_vec() });
+            let queued = records.iter().find(|record| record.write_id != original_id).context("queued original lost")?;
+            anyhow::ensure!(queued.state == NativePtyWriteState::NotSent);
+            anyhow::ensure!(queued.input == NativePtyWriteInput::Data { bytes: b"queued-never-sent\r".to_vec() });
+            let closed = timeout(Duration::from_secs(12), seat.close()).await??;
+            anyhow::ensure!(closed.session_end_observed);
+            let after = fixture.gate.observation();
+            anyhow::ensure!(after.write_polls == at_cancel.write_polls && after.bytes_written == at_cancel.bytes_written);
+            anyhow::ensure!(fixture.received.lock().unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner()).input.is_empty());
+            Ok(())
+        }.await;
+        let closed = close_seat(&mut fixture, &seat).await;
+        checked?;
+        closed?;
+
+        // 4. The original underlying flush error reaches Unknown with the full
+        // input; later admission is refused and does not become a retry.
+        let (mut fixture, session) = Fixture::open(false).await?;
+        let seat = SshPtySeat::spawn(session, seat_handle(), 80, 24);
+        let checked: Result<()> = async {
+            let handle = seat_handle();
+            let fence = fence();
+            fixture.gate.set(GateMode::HoldFlush);
+            let mut pending = Box::pin(seat.submit(&handle, "original-flush-error", &fence));
+            reach_gate(pending.as_mut(), &fixture.gate, GateMode::HoldFlush).await?;
+            fixture.gate.set(GateMode::FailFlush);
+            let response = timeout(WAIT, pending).await??;
+            anyhow::ensure!(matches!(&response.confirmation, AnswerConfirmation::Unknown { reason } if reason.contains(ORIGINAL_ERROR)));
+            let records = seat.write_observations();
+            anyhow::ensure!(records.len() == 1 && records[0].state == NativePtyWriteState::Unknown);
+            anyhow::ensure!(records[0].input == NativePtyWriteInput::Data { bytes: b"original-flush-error\r".to_vec() });
+            anyhow::ensure!(response.detail.as_deref().is_some_and(|detail| detail.contains(ORIGINAL_ERROR)));
+            let refused = timeout(WAIT, seat.submit(&handle, "not-a-retry", &fence)).await??;
+            anyhow::ensure!(matches!(refused.confirmation, AnswerConfirmation::NotSent { .. }));
+            Ok(())
+        }.await;
+        let closed = close_seat(&mut fixture, &seat).await;
+        checked?;
+        closed?;
+
+        // 5. A peer closes the channel while the original ciphertext cannot
+        // flush. The actual barrier must refuse even after the stream unblocks.
+        let (mut fixture, mut session) = Fixture::open(false).await?;
+        let checked: Result<()> = async {
+            fixture.gate.set(GateMode::HoldWrite);
+            let (reader, writer) = session.split_io();
+            let mut pending = Box::pin(writer.send(b"original-closed-channel"));
+            reach_gate(pending.as_mut(), &fixture.gate, GateMode::HoldWrite).await?;
+            fixture.close_channel().await?;
+            let observed_close = timeout(WAIT, async {
+                while let Some(event) = reader.recv().await {
+                    if event == NativePtyEvent::Closed { return true; }
+                }
+                false
+            }).await?;
+            anyhow::ensure!(observed_close, "peer channel close was not actually observed");
+            fixture.gate.set(GateMode::Pass);
+            let result = timeout(WAIT, pending).await?;
+            eprintln!("PTY original closed-channel flush result: {result:?}");
+            let error = result.err().context("removed channel incorrectly received a successful flush receipt")?;
+            anyhow::ensure!(error.to_string().contains("channel closed before its outbound flush boundary"));
+            Ok(())
+        }.await;
+        let close = timeout(Duration::from_secs(12), session.close(Duration::from_millis(500))).await;
+        eprintln!("PTY original removed-channel close observation: {close:?}");
+        let stopped = fixture.finish().await;
+        checked?;
+        anyhow::ensure!(close?.session_end_observed);
+        stopped?;
+        Ok(())
